title: AI Operations Assistant who thinks in systems | Work directly with founder | Grow into running client operations
description:
Do you think in systems, want to help companies scale with AI, and can you stay focused on the bottleneck? Then please watch this video: 



If you have only studied IT, this might not be the right job for you.

If you have studied Business and IT, this could be the perfect job for you.

If you have just studied Business, it might be the right job for you.



I would like to see signs of exceptional performance or thinking.



WHAT THIS IS



I run an Irish company that builds AI-driven operations for growing businesses. Right now I'm fractional Operations Manager for multiple agencies, where I build the systems, automations, and tracking that let them scale. I automate everything that can be automated. This role is my right hand for everything that still needs a sharp human.



You would be working directly with me. And you would not be my first Filipino teammate: over the years I have worked with 20+ people from the Philippines through Upwork and OnlineJobs.ph, so I know how to make this work well for both sides. As the work grows, this role grows with it.



A bit about me: I started programming at 13, had my first client at 14, and left the standard education path to learn on my own. I was working as a developer at 17 and made this flowchart at 19 with no guidance: 
 

Since then I have built systems and automations for 50+ companies, including founders from the Forbes 30 Under 30 list.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



The goal of this role: you end up running the operations of one or more of our client companies. You start as my right hand and take over one system at a time.



1. Map how a business actually works. On live calls with me, you lay out flowcharts of how a client gets customers, delivers, and gets paid

2. Find the bottleneck. Work out which part of the system is holding the company back and what to fix first

3. Build the systems from those flowcharts in tools like Notion and GoHighLevel (no prior experience with these tools needed), using Claude and other AI tools to build fast. I will teach you my workflows, and I expect you to get good at them

4. Turn what we build into procedures other people can follow: you take a recording or a live walkthrough, write the procedure, then run the task from your own procedure to prove it works

5. Keep the systems true. Check that tasks, records, and data across several clients match reality, catch what looks wrong, and fix the cause, not only the record

6. Roll out changes. Make sure the people using a system know what changed and how to use it

7. Take ownership. One process at a time, you become the person responsible for it end to end, including improving it



In the first weeks, most of your time goes to points 4 and 5, because that is how you learn the systems. A small part of the role is also personal logistics for me (for example scheduling with my chef, keeping household supplies stocked).



HOW WE WORK TOGETHER



The work has two modes.



BUILD MODE: when we are diving into a system and building it out, we work LIVE on a Zoom call. Both on, screen sharing, I figure out what needs to happen, you take each task the moment it is clear and do it while I keep working on the next thing, and we review and adjust on the spot. Think of it like mob programming: no briefs sitting in a queue for two days, no handover delays, the system gets built fast and you learn extremely quickly because you see the whole thinking process. I have worked this way with people from the Philippines before, sometimes long days on the same call, and it is intense and energizing. If that sounds draining to you, this is not your role. If it sounds fun, keep reading.



RUN MODE: once a system is built and figured out, the work becomes calmer. You get checklists and short screen recordings (Loom) as instructions, you work through them on your own time within our overlap hours, and you send back your results. Over time you graduate to owning these processes fully.



Most weeks are a mix of both. You get real responsibility fast if you show you can carry it.



THE DEAL



1. Part time to start, around 20 hours per week. Paid per hour worked: $5-7/hour, depending on experience

2. Hours vary from week to week. Some weeks are lighter, and busy weeks can reach 40+ hours. I need someone who wants those hours

3. 13th month pay

4. First raise review after 90 days, tied to the processes you own, not time served

5. Working hours: I'm in Europe, so overlap with my day means your AFTERNOON and EVENING (around 15:00-24:00 Philippine time). I need at least 3 hours of overlap. Your mornings stay yours, and the normal working hours are nothing like the graveyard shifts of a US client. The exact schedule inside that window is something we agree on together



Side projects and other gigs are fine. I would honestly rather hire someone who builds things. The deal is simple: the hours we agree on are sacred, and when I need extra hours on short notice (24 to 48 hours), this role comes first. If you can commit to that, everything else is your time.



WHO YOU ARE



1. You think in systems: when one thing changes, you ask what else it affects. You have mapped how work moves between people in a business, not only how IT systems connect

2. You have used Claude Code for actual work and created skills

3. Detail-oriented: you follow instructions exactly and flag anything that looks off instead of guessing

4. You enjoy working live on a call: screen sharing, getting feedback, adjusting in real time

5. Strong written and spoken English (we talk a lot on calls)

6. Reliable internet and your own computer, good enough for long Zoom calls with screen share and remote control. Please test this before you apply

7. Available now, with room to grow your hours

8. Hungry. You want to learn how modern businesses are actually built



HOW THE HIRING WORKS



1. You apply (see below). I review every application that follows the instructions within 48 hours

2. Shortlisted candidates get a career timeline template to fill in: your work history as a timeline, with the highlights, the lowlights, and why you moved on each time, plus two references. Specifics matter more than polish, and I do contact references

3. A short video call with me, where I ask about your timeline

4. Then a PAID live working session: you join me on Zoom, we work on real tasks together, real pay. Both of us see if it fits

5. If it fits, we start properly



HOW TO APPLY



Send these three things (short and honest beats long and polished):



1. Links to flowcharts you have made. At least one must show a BUSINESS process: how work moves between people in a company (for example client onboarding, order handling, hiring). IT system diagrams are welcome in addition. If yours are confidential, map a process from a business you know well.

2. A Loom video of 2 minutes or less where you walk me through the business flowchart, tell me one thing you got wrong in the first version and what you changed, and introduce yourself.

3. A link to something you have built with AI tools that I can open and look at: an application, a dashboard, an automation, or a working tool. If it cannot be shared publicly, send a short screen recording of you using it. A description alone does not count. Add one or two lines on what it does and which parts you built yourself.



And answer this one question:



4. What other work or commitments do you have right now, and what is the maximum weekly hours you could reliably give me?

title: Direct-response Video Editor - Meta Ads + AI video (Higgsfield) - $800-$1000/month - Read the whole post

We’re Vier je stad, a Dutch brand selling handmade glass Christmas ornaments inspired by famous buildings. We spend quite a lot on Meta every month and creative is the most important lever that matters to us. We want one editor to own our video output.



This is direct-response editing, not video production. If your reel is weddings, corporate, travel or long-form YouTube, this isn't your job and we won't be a good client for you.



What you’d be doing

- From product images creating short AI videos in Higgsfield while preserving product details

- Cutting UGC footage into Meta ads, 9:16 and 4:5

- Editing to AI voiceover with clean sync and pacing

- Generating AI B-roll and AI UGC in Higgsfield, and making it not look like AI

- Producing hook variants — same body, 4–6 different openings, tested against each other

- Captions, pattern interrupts, retention pacing, end cards

- Creating short video ads around gifting, city pride and memories of home



How we work

Our creative workflow combines visual concepts with different products and buying motivations: city pride, memories of home, meaningful gifts, and collecting. You’ll develop a concept, adapt it across different building ornaments, and create variations for testing. Successful concepts are then rolled out across other cities.



How you work

• You take initiative, notices small visual mistakes, and communicates proactively.

• You can follow an existing workflow while also suggesting improvements.

• You check AI-generated content carefully against our product references rather than accepting the first result. If something is taking too long or a brief is unclear, you flag it early and suggest a practical next step.

Tools & skills

title: Driver Care Advocate & Fleet Support Specialist (Remote)
description:
About the Role



Behind every steering wheel in our fleet is a dedicated man or woman carrying the weight of the day: tight schedules, unpredictable highway traffic, demanding routes, and everyday life waiting at home. When frustrations mount or the day turns chaotic, our drivers do not need an armchair therapist, a corporate lecture, or unsolicited advice.



They need a calm, steady anchor on the other end of the line -someone who listens, helps them take a breath, and de-escalates high-stress moments before they spiral out of control.



We are seeking a warm, grounded Driver Care Advocate to serve as a supportive presence for our drivers across the Southeast. Beyond phone de-escalation, this role participates in driver onboarding, team meetings, and virtual check-ins. Your mission is simple: listen without judgment, speak peace into chaotic situations, help drivers decompress, and remind them that they are valued, respected, and never on the road alone.



Core Responsibilities

Active Listening & Emotional De-escalation: Step directly into tense, high-pressure situations to talk drivers "off the ledge" when route frustrations, road delays, or personal stresses threaten to derail their day.



Proactive Check-Ins: Conduct friendly, low-pressure outbound calls to drivers on the road just to ask: "How is your route treating you today?" and offer an open ear.



Holding Safe Space Without Giving Unsolicited Advice: Allow drivers to vent and leave the stress on the call without attempting marital therapy, legal advice, or financial consulting.



Mindset & Breath Resets: Guide drivers through practical, immediate calming techniques - encouraging them to pause, take deep breaths, step out of the cab to stretch, and refocus on finishing their route safely.



Video Engagement & Onboarding Presence: Welcome new drivers during virtual onboarding sessions, attend operational video meetings, and connect with drivers during lot breaks.



Preserving Driver Morale: Serve as an advocate whose warmth, consistency, and genuine care keep good drivers engaged, valued, and retained in our fleet.



Our Culture & Values

We operate on a strong foundation of servant leadership, personal grace, and moral grounding. Our ideal advocate is someone who is comfortable speaking blessings, offering words of faith, hope, and prayer when welcomed by the driver, and reassuring our team that God has their steps in His hands and that everything is going to be okay.



Mandatory Requirements

100% Native-Level, Accent-Free Spoken English: Crystal-clear verbal clarity and a clean, neutral accent are strictly non-negotiable. Drivers communicate through hands-free vehicle audio, Bluetooth, and cellular lines with background road noise; there can be zero accent friction, lag, or difficulty understanding what is being said.



High-Influence ("I") Presence: A naturally soothing, confident, and persuasive vocal tone that instantly lowers the temperature of an agitated driver.



Professional On-Camera Presence: A warm, engaging presentation on video calls with a quiet, organized, and distraction-free remote work environment.



Firm Boundary Discipline: The wisdom to offer surface-level comfort, encouragement, and active listening without overstepping into clinical psychology or operational dispatch management.



Unshakable Composure: The ability to remain patient, unhurried, and peaceful even when the person on the other end is angry, overwhelmed, or in panic mode.



Reliability: Consistent availability and immediate responsiveness during scheduled operational fleet hours (US Eastern Time).



How to Apply (Required Video Introduction)

We do not review traditional text resumes for this position. Because this role lives across phone de-escalation, driver onboarding, and team video meetings, we evaluate personal presence, vocal warmth, and clear communication first.



To be considered, you must submit a link to a 60-to-90-second video recording (using a free tool like 
, a smartphone video uploaded to Google Drive, or an unlisted YouTube link) covering two things:



Brief Introduction (15–20 seconds): Introduce yourself and share why supporting frontline drivers through encouragement and active listening resonates with you.



The De-escalation Scenario (45–60 seconds): Simulate how you would address this real-world situation:



"You are reaching out to Marcus, a driver who has been stuck in bumper-to-bumper traffic for two hours, is running late for his afternoon pickups, and is threatening to park the vehicle and walk off the job because he is fed up. Show us how you would open that conversation, help him take a breath, and de-escalate the moment."



****ATTENTION*****  (Applications submitted without a video link will be automatically disqualified.)

title: Outbound Appointment Setter, US Solar | Paid Every Friday + High Commission

But my apologies, I'm talking too much... just to see if this even makes sense for you, how much is the electric company making you pay each month?"



__________________________________________________________________

title: Social Media Marketing Manager – Instagram Growth & Personal Branding

We are a social media agency that builds and grows personal brands on Instagram. We’re looking for an experienced marketer who truly understands how Instagram works, not just someone who posts content.

What You’ll Do

Recognize patterns in viral content and turn them into repeatable concepts



Optimize videos: hooks, first 3 seconds, pacing, captions, on-screen text, covers and CTAs

- Identify upcoming payment deadlines and cash flow concerns.

- Report discrepancies and financial risks directly to ownership.

- Coordinate administrative tasks without independently authorizing major financial transactions.



**6. Reporting & Accountability**



- Provide a concise daily operations report.

- Conduct weekly management meetings.

- Monitor KPIs across property management, construction, and administrative departments.

- Identify problems early and propose solutions.

- Ensure tasks are completed without constant reminders from ownership.



### Required Qualifications



- Minimum **3–5 years of experience** in U.S. real estate operations, property management, or construction coordination.

- At least 4 years of experience managing remote teams or virtual assistants.

- Demonstrated experience writing and implementing SOPs.

- Strong knowledge of U.S. rental property management processes.

- Experience coordinating with American tenants, contractors, and vendors.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

- Experience with project management software such as ClickUp, Asana, 
, or Trello.

- Proficiency with spreadsheets, reporting dashboards, and tracking operational KPIs.

- Ability to work independently during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



### Preferred Qualifications



- Experience managing large rental portfolios (50+ units).

- Background in residential construction, renovation, or maintenance coordination.

- Experience with RentRedi, AppFolio, Buildium, or similar software.

- Experience overseeing multiple departments or remote employees.

- Ability to create automation systems and improve operational efficiency.



### What We're Looking For



We value ownership, accountability, communication, and results.



Our ideal candidate:



- Does not need to be reminded repeatedly to complete tasks.

- Follows up proactively until issues are resolved.

- Can confidently manage employees and difficult conversations.

- Thinks ahead and identifies potential problems before they happen.

- Is comfortable making routine decisions independently.

- Understands when to escalate important matters to ownership.

- Builds systems instead of relying on memory or constant supervision.



**We are not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks. We want a leader who makes sure the entire team delivers results.**



### Compensation & Growth

- Full-time, long-term opportunity.

- Performance-based salary reviews.

- Opportunity to grow into a Director of Operations or COO-level position.

- Direct collaboration with company ownership.

title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator - Contract Specialist

Strong background in retail residential sales and listings. Stable work history with professional references. Ability to manage multiple active files without micromanagement.

REO or foreclosure transaction experience. Familiarity with transaction management systems and compliance standards. This experience will be weighted in the hiring process. Candidates with this experience will be reviewed first.

Professional communication with clients agents inspectors and escrow. Comfortable working independently in a fast paced environment. Coachable, loyal, and interested in long term growth.



Work Requirements



High speed internet and a quiet professional work environment. Proficient in Microsoft Office Word Excel Outlook. Ability to work US Pacific Time between 8 AM and 5 PM Monday - Friday.

title: AI UGC Image Creator - Opportunity to Grow into a Creative Designer
description:
We’re looking for someone who can create highly realistic AI-generated lifestyle images for a fashion brand targeting British women aged 40 and above.



You’ll initially create three UGC-style images per product:



- One branded unboxing photo: the product inside an open package featuring our logo and branding.

- One casual selfie: a woman wearing the product, taking a natural selfie or mirror selfie at home.

- One everyday lifestyle photo: a woman wearing the product, photographed by someone else in a relaxed setting.



These are AI-generated visual concepts, rather than verified customer testimonials.



What we’re looking for



Your images should have the realism of everyday phone photography: natural lighting, realistic skin texture, relaxed poses and believable surroundings. Small imperfections in framing should make the images feel spontaneous.



Product accuracy is essential. Colours, fabric, shape, fit and details must match the references provided. Hands, reflections, packaging and logos must also look convincing.



Where relevant, the images should reflect the product offer—for example, showing two colours together for a buy one, get one free deal.



Your responsibilities



We’ll provide product photos, branding, the product page and a brief. You’ll develop three distinct concepts, generate the images and carefully check the results before delivery.



You should be comfortable working independently, spotting visual errors and refining your work. Experience with AI image generation and image editing is essential.



Opportunity to grow



The role starts with these three images per product. If your work consistently meets our quality standards, you can grow into a Creative Designer role, creating static ads, developing concepts and hooks, and producing AI 
 videos for
 and Instagram campaigns.



How to apply



Please share examples of your most realistic AI-generated fashion or lifestyle images, the tools you use and your typical turnaround time for three images.

title: OPERATIONS & SYSTEMS VIRTUAL ASSISTANT
description:
Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | European Health & Wellness Business



We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented and reliable Operations & Systems Virtual Assistant to support the daily operations of a growing premium health and wellness company based in Iceland.



This is not primarily a marketing, social media or customer service position.



We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with systems, spreadsheets, data, checklists, operational processes and making sure everything is accurate, organised and completed on time.



You will work closely with our CEO and operations team to help build a more structured, efficient and reliable business.



The ideal candidate is someone who notices when something is missing, identifies inconsistencies, follows up independently and takes ownership of recurring responsibilities without needing constant reminders.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



1. DAILY OPERATIONAL CHECKS



- Review our booking system and check that appointments, schedules and records are accurate.

- Identify missing information, booking conflicts and inconsistencies.

- Check that required forms, labels, notes and administrative records are completed.

- Perform routine operational checks using established checklists.

- Review operational evidence, including camera checks where assigned, following written procedures.

- Record issues, follow up and escalate exceptions when necessary.

- Help ensure that daily operational procedures are consistently followed.



2. DATA MANAGEMENT & ADMINISTRATION



- Maintain and update spreadsheets, trackers and databases.

- Organize and reconcile information across different business systems.

- Identify missing, duplicated or incorrect information.

- Prepare accurate operational summaries and reports.

- Maintain organised digital files, records and documentation.

- Support data administration in our booking, customer management and internal systems.



3. STAFF PERFORMANCE & REPORTING ADMINISTRATION



- Collect and organise data for our staff performance system.

- Maintain monthly performance tracking spreadsheets and scorecards.

- Review operational records against established performance criteria.

- Prepare performance reports for management review.

- Track working hours, schedules and relevant operational data.

- Prepare payroll and payment reconciliation information for management approval.



This is an administrative and reporting responsibility. 

Final employee evaluations, payroll approvals and management decisions remain with the company.



4. BOOKING, CUSTOMER & SUBSCRIPTION ADMINISTRATION



- Support administration in Acuity Scheduling and other booking systems.

- Check customer records and booking-related information.

- Review subscription and recurring payment records.

- Identify failed payments, missing information and discrepancies.

- Prepare follow-up tasks according to established procedures.

- Escalate customer situations requiring management decisions or Icelandic-language communication.



5. SYSTEMS, SOPS & PROCESS IMPROVEMENT



- Maintain our internal Notion workspace.

- Create and improve checklists, SOPs and operational documentation.

- Identify repetitive tasks that could be simplified or automated.

- Help build and maintain automations using tools such as Zapier or Make.

- Improve the organisation and reliability of our internal workflows.

- Make sure recurring tasks have clear procedures, deadlines and accountability.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You may be a great fit if you:



Have previous experience as an Operations VA, Administrative VA, Executive Assistant or similar.

Have excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.

Are confident using Google Sheets and Excel, including formulas and data reconciliation.

Are comfortable using Notion.

Learn new software quickly.

Enjoy structured, recurring administrative work.

Are proactive in identifying errors and inconsistencies.

Can follow detailed procedures consistently.

Have excellent written English.

Are reliable, responsive and well organized.

Can manage your own workload and deadlines.

Are comfortable handling confidential business and personnel information.

Enjoy improving systems and processes.



Experience with any of the following is an advantage:



Acuity Scheduling

Shopify administration

Notion

Google Sheets / Excel

Zapier

AI tools and workflow automation

Staff reporting, payroll preparation or data reconciliation



You do not need experience with every system. Strong organisational skills, accuracy and the ability to learn quickly are more important.



HOW WE WORK



- We use Notion as our central operating system for tasks, recurring responsibilities, documentation and time tracking.



- We value clear communication, accountability and independent problem-solving.



- We do not want someone who simply waits for the next task.



- We want someone who can take ownership of agreed recurring processes and make sure they are completed accurately and consistently.



- For example, instead of waiting to be asked to check whether yesterday's booking records are correct, you would already know that this is part of your recurring responsibilities.



- If you find an issue, you document it, investigate it where appropriate and report it with a clear recommendation or next step.



- Our goal is to build reliable systems that operate consistently without constant CEO supervision.



ABOUT THE HOUSE OF BEAUTY



The House of Beauty is a premium, multi-award-winning health, beauty and wellness clinic based in Reykjavík, Iceland.

We have been operating for more than 8 years and have delivered over 50,000 treatments.



We are now strengthening our operational infrastructure, improving internal systems and building a more efficient and scalable business.

You will play an important role in making sure our daily operations, data and administrative processes run smoothly.



WORKING HOURS & COMPENSATION



Part-time: approximately 10–20 hours per week.

Initial workload: approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the potential to increase to 20 hours as responsibilities and operational systems develop.



We are looking for someone who has the availability and interest to grow with the role.

Flexible working arrangements, with agreed daily check-in and task completion deadlines.

Long-term opportunity for the right person.



Hourly compensation based on experience and demonstrated skills.

Time tracking through our internal Notion system.

Initial three-month performance review period.



We care more about accuracy, ownership, reliability and results than simply logging hours.



HOW TO APPLY



Please start your application with the words “THOB Operations” so we know you have read the full description.



Please answer the following questions:



1. Experience: Tell us about your previous experience with administrative, operational or systems-based virtual assistant work.



2. Software skills: Rate your experience from 1–10 with Google Sheets / Excel, Notion, Acuity Scheduling or other booking systems, CRM systems, Zapier, and Shopify.



3. Accuracy: Describe a real situation where you discovered an error or discrepancy in business records or data. How did you identify it, and what did you do?

title: Market Research Analyst – Australian Commercial Cleaning Industry
description:
# Job Title: Market Research Analyst – Australian Commercial Cleaning Industry



**Job Type:** Part-Time / Freelance / Project-Based  

**Location:** Remote  

**Target Market:** Australia – All States and Territories  

**Industry:** Commercial Cleaning and Cleaning Services



## About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Market Research Analyst to conduct comprehensive market research for a new cleaning business we are planning to establish in Australia.



The goal is to understand the Australian cleaning industry, identify profitable business opportunities, analyse competitors, research market pricing, and develop a clear picture of how to enter and grow in this industry.



We need someone who can conduct detailed research, verify information, contact businesses when necessary, and present findings in a professional report that will help us make informed business decisions.



This is not just a data collection role. We need someone who can analyse the market and provide practical business recommendations.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Australian Cleaning Industry Research

- Research the commercial cleaning industry across Australia.

- Analyse demand for cleaning services in different states, cities, and regions.

- Identify the most promising customer segments and service categories.

- Research industry trends, growth opportunities, and potential challenges.



### 2. Competitor Analysis

- Identify established cleaning companies, smaller operators, and franchises.

- Research their services, target customers, geographical coverage, and business models.

- Analyse their marketing strategies, strengths, and weaknesses.

- Identify opportunities for a new business to compete effectively.



### 3. Market Pricing Research

- Research what cleaning companies charge across Australia.

- Compare hourly rates, fixed-price contracts, and other pricing models.

- Investigate pricing for office cleaning, commercial buildings, medical centres, schools, warehouses, and other relevant premises.

- Contact cleaning companies or prospective customers where appropriate to verify market rates.

- Explain how prices vary by location, job size, frequency, and service requirements.



### 4. Customer and Contract Research

- Identify businesses and organisations that purchase cleaning services.

- Research how to find commercial cleaning contracts.

- Investigate private-sector opportunities, property management companies, facility managers, and relevant government procurement opportunities.

- Identify tender websites and explain the process of applying for cleaning contracts.

- Research typical contract requirements and customer expectations.



### 5. Business Setup and Operating Costs

- Research the costs involved in starting and operating a cleaning business in Australia.

- Investigate equipment, cleaning supplies, insurance, staff wages, training, and transportation costs.

- Research relevant licences, workplace safety requirements, and other compliance obligations.

- Analyse the difference between operating with employees, subcontractors, and owner-operators.



### 6. Profitability and Business Model Analysis

- Estimate potential revenue and operating costs using clearly stated assumptions.

- Develop example profit-and-loss scenarios for small, medium, and larger cleaning operations.

- Compare recurring cleaning contracts with one-off jobs.

- Identify the business models with the strongest potential based on evidence.

- Highlight risks, challenges, and factors that could affect profitability.



### 7. Final Research Report

Prepare a professional report that includes:

- Australian cleaning industry overview.

- Competitor database and pricing comparison.

- State-by-state market opportunities.

- Target customer segments.

- Startup and ongoing operating costs.

- Example financial projections.

- Contract acquisition strategies.

- Recommended entry strategy and action plan.



## Required Skills

- Previous experience in market research, business analysis, or industry research.

- Strong online research and data verification skills.

- Experience with competitor pricing analysis.

- Excellent Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Ability to prepare professional reports and financial comparisons.

- Strong written English and attention to detail.

- Ability to contact businesses and verify information when necessary.



Experience researching Australian businesses or the commercial cleaning industry is an advantage.



## Expected Deliverables



The successful candidate must provide a detailed, evidence-based market research report with sources, links, dates, comparison tables, calculations, and practical recommendations.



We are looking for actionable business intelligence, not a generic report copied from the internet.



## How to Apply



Please provide:

1. Your previous market research experience.

2. Examples of research reports you have completed.

3. Your experience analysing competitors and pricing.

4. The tools and methods you use to verify information.

5. Your proposed approach to researching the Australian cleaning industry.

6. Your estimated timeframe and total project cost.



Please explain how you would approach this project before applying.

title: Operations Transformation Lead/Operations Builder

Required

Important

We are looking for builders, not caretakers.

Compensation & Growth

title: Graphic Designer, Copywriter & Social Media Assistant (Squarespace / Canva), with VA Duties
description:
I run a small Squarespace web design and copywriting studio in Canada, working mostly with therapists, consultants and other service businesses. I am looking for one creative person to work alongside me, part time to start, with the hours and pay growing as you take on more.

Scheduling posts and keeping a simple content calendar up to date

title: Short-Form Video Editor for a Creative Content Studio — $50–$100 per Video, Steady Monthly Work
description:
ABOUT BRANDLYSS



Brandlyss is a content studio based in the United States. We build the digital presence of scholars, artists, and practice-led entrepreneurs. Our clients have serious bodies of work: books, exhibitions, research, performances, and portfolios. The videos we make have to be as considered as the work they present.



We are growing fast and adding editors to our roster. This is ongoing per-video work, not a one-off project.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



- Short-form vertical videos for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts, usually 1 to 3 minutes

- Talking-head footage combined with archival images, artworks, book covers, and B-roll

- On-screen captions, name cards, and titles of works

- Motion graphics and layered animation where the story calls for it



WHAT MAKES SOMEONE GOOD AT THIS JOB



- You read the script before you cut. We supply an approved script for every video. Captions are pasted from that script, never auto-transcribed. Names of people and titles of works must appear exactly as written.

- You make creative decisions without being asked: pacing, B-roll, music, and where an image should land.

- You find your own B-roll and supporting images when we do not supply them.

- Your edits feel refined, not loud. No meme effects, no over-editing, and no AI-generated visuals or voices unless we ask for them.

- You give a delivery date and you hit it.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2 or more years editing short-form video for clients, with a portfolio to show it. Open to less experience with a solid portfolio

- Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, plus After Effects or an equivalent for motion graphics

- Strong color correction and clean audio: noise removal, levels, and music mix

- Excellent written English, with close attention to spelling and punctuation

- Reliable internet and a computer that handles 4K footage

- Familiar with 
, where all feedback arrives as timestamped comments

- Day-to-day communication on WhatsApp, with a reply within one working day; comfortable with Slack or other messaging platforms



NICE TO HAVE



- Graphic design for carousels and static posts

- Experience with documentary, museum, academic, arts, fashion or publishing content

- Storyboarding from a script or a concept



WHAT EVERY VIDEO INCLUDES



- Length: 1 to 3 minutes, vertical

- Captions: included in every video, pasted from our script

- Motion graphics: included in every video, such as name cards, titles, and layered animation

- Revisions: included in the rate. Every cut goes through our internal review first, and any fixes needed to make it client-ready are part of the edit. After that, expect up to 2 rounds of client feedback.

- Volume: 4 to 6 videos a month guaranteed once you prove consistent quality and delivery. Until then, work is assigned video by video.



PAY AND HOW IT WORKS



- Paid trial: one test edit of 60 seconds or less for $40 USD, paid on delivery whether or not we use it

- After the trial: $50 USD per video to start

- Once you prove consistent quality and on-time delivery: $55 to $60 per video with 4 to 6 videos guaranteed every month. Senior editors, whose first cuts are client-ready without creative direction from us, earn $100 per video.

- Bonuses at the higher tiers for clean first drafts, on-time streaks, and high-performing videos

- You work your own hours. First drafts are due within 2-3 days of receiving footage, depending on the length of footage, and revisions are due within 24 hours.

- Every brief and every round of feedback comes from one person, our founder.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that skip any step are not reviewed.



1. Use this exact subject line: Brandlyss Editor: Your Full Name

2. Send 3 links to short-form videos you edited yourself. For each one, write one sentence on what you did and what you did not do.

3. Tell us your editing software, whether you have used 
, and how many videos you can take on each week.

4. Tell us your first-draft turnaround for a 90-second video.

5. Complete the caption check. Below is a script line and the caption an editor typed from it. List every difference between them.



Script: Barkley L. Hendricks painted Lawdy Mama in 1969, and it changed how I look at portraiture.



Caption: Barclay L. Hendricks painted Lawdy Mamma in 1969 and it changed how I look at portaiture.



Shortlisted editors are invited to the paid trial.

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Content Assistant
description:
Job Opening: Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Content Assistant



Remote | Part-time | Long-term collaboration | Based in the Philippines



About the role



I’m looking for a reliable, creative and proactive video editor and social media assistant to help me stay consistent on Instagram and TikTok.



I create Dutch-speaking content around lifestyle, personal development, business, content creation and entrepreneurship. I want to build a strong and consistent online presence without having to manage every editing, planning and posting task myself.



I’m looking for someone who can do more than just edit videos. I want someone who thinks along with me, spots opportunities, suggests content ideas and helps me turn the content I already create into as much valuable content as possible.



The goal is simple: create a consistent content system that allows us to publish regularly without me having to think about every single post.



1. Video editing



Your main responsibility will be editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.



Your tasks include:



* Editing talking-head videos in Dutch.

* Creating engaging hooks, adding captions and highlighting important words.

* Removing unnecessary pauses, filler words, mistakes and repetitive sections.

* Adding relevant B-roll, zoom-ins, transitions, sound effects and background music when appropriate.

* Improving pacing, storytelling and viewer retention.

* Creating clean, professional and visually engaging videos that match my personal brand.

* Exporting videos in the correct format and quality for Instagram and TikTok.

* Maintaining consistent editing quality across all content.



Important: My videos are spoken in Dutch. You must be able to understand spoken Dutch well enough to identify the key message, edit accurately, recognize important moments and create meaningful clips. Captions must also be accurate in Dutch. Automatic captions must always be checked and corrected.



You do not necessarily need to speak Dutch fluently, but you must demonstrate that you can work accurately with Dutch-language content.



2. Content repurposing



I want to get more value out of every video I record.



For example, one longer video could become several shorter videos, each focusing on a different point, lesson, story or strong hook.



Your responsibilities include:



* Identifying the strongest moments in longer recordings.

* Turning longer videos into multiple standalone short-form clips.

* Finding different hooks and angles within the same recording.

* Making sure each clip has a clear message and makes sense on its own.

* Suggesting alternative edits or opening hooks when they could improve the content.

* Avoiding repetitive clips that communicate essentially the same thing.



The goal is not simply to produce as many clips as possible. The goal is to create as many useful, engaging and relevant pieces of content as possible from the original footage.



3. Content batching and planning



I want us to work in content batches instead of handling every video as a separate task.



This means helping me organize and prepare content in advance so that we can maintain a consistent posting schedule.



Your responsibilities include:



* Helping organize raw footage and content ideas.

* Working with me to prepare content batches.

* Keeping track of which videos need editing, approval or publishing.

* Creating a clear content calendar.

* Suggesting relevant content ideas based on my existing content, audience and goals.

* Identifying opportunities to turn recurring themes into content series.

* Helping repurpose existing footage when I have limited time to record new videos.



I will provide the original footage, context and overall direction. I expect you to help turn that material into a structured, manageable content workflow.



4. Instagram and TikTok management



Once videos are edited and approved, you will help prepare and publish the content.



Tasks include:



* Preparing and scheduling approved videos on Instagram and TikTok.

* Writing or suggesting relevant captions.

* Suggesting suitable calls to action.

* Researching relevant keywords and hashtags when appropriate.

* Checking that videos, captions and covers are ready before publishing.

* Maintaining the agreed posting schedule.

* Keeping track of published content and upcoming posts.

* Flagging any technical issues or missing information before the scheduled publication date.



You must be comfortable working with social media scheduling and publishing tools. Access to my accounts will be provided through an agreed, secure process.



5. Creative thinking and initiative



This is a very important part of the role.



I don’t want someone who simply waits for instructions for every small task. I want someone who can think independently and identify opportunities to improve our content.



For example:



* “This part of the video would work better as a separate Reel.”

* “We could create three different hooks for this topic.”

* “This video would make a good recurring content series.”

* “We have enough footage here for next week’s posts.”

* “This editing style could make the message clearer.”

* “We should prepare these videos in advance to stay consistent.”



I value creative thinking, attention to detail, organization and solutions rather than just identifying problems.



You are encouraged to share ideas and recommendations. I will make the final decisions on content direction and brand positioning.



6. Requirements



I’m looking for someone who:



* Has experience editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.

* Can demonstrate a portfolio of relevant video-editing work.

* Can accurately understand spoken Dutch in video recordings.

* Can create accurate Dutch captions and subtitles.

* Understands short-form storytelling, hooks, pacing and audience retention.

* Is comfortable repurposing long-form content into shorter clips.

* Is organized, dependable and able to meet deadlines.

* Communicates clearly and proactively.

* Can work independently without needing constant supervision.

* Is open to feedback and can apply revisions correctly.

* Is interested in a long-term working relationship.



Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar editing software is welcome. Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, TikTok’s publishing tools and content calendars is an advantage.



7. Communication and workflow



I expect clear communication, realistic deadlines and consistent delivery.



You should:



* Confirm that you understand the task before starting when instructions are unclear.

* Let me know early if a deadline is at risk.

* Keep files organized and clearly labeled.

* Track the status of each video.

* Apply agreed feedback to future edits to reduce repeated revisions.

* Suggest improvements when you see an opportunity.



I want us to build a reliable system that becomes more efficient over time.



8. Application instructions



To apply, please provide:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Your video-editing portfolio, especially talking-head videos, Reels or TikToks.

3. Examples of videos where you have edited captions, hooks and short-form clips.

4. The editing software and scheduling tools you use.

5. Your experience working with content in Dutch or other languages you do not speak natively.

6. Your availability, preferred working hours and expected hourly or monthly rate.

7. A brief explanation of how you would turn one 10-minute talking-head video into multiple engaging short-form videos.



Please also include the word CONTENT SYSTEM at the beginning of your application so I know you have read the full job description.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small, paid editing test using Dutch-language footage. The test will help us evaluate your editing quality, understanding of the spoken content, caption accuracy and ability to identify strong short-form clips.



I’m looking for a dependable creative partner who wants to help build a consistent and effective content workflow over the long term.

title: Loan Processor – Australian Mortgage Broker (Application to Settlement)
description:
Loan Processor (Remote, Australian Mortgage Brokerage)



We are an Australian mortgage brokerage looking for an experienced Loan Processor to manage residential loan files from application through to settlement. You'll work directly with the broker, take each deal from his written instructions, prepare the client proposal, and own the file until it settles, keeping clients and lenders informed at every step.



What you'll do:



• Receive deals with written instructions from the broker and set them up in our CRM (MyCRM)

• Prepare the client Game Plan/proposal document, send it to the client and follow up until signed

What you'll do:

• Receive approved deals with full written instructions and set them up in our CRM (MyCRM)

• Prepare and send client proposal documents and follow up until signed

• Lodge applications through lender ApplyOnline (AOL) portals

• Complete a compliance checklist on every file before submission

• Manage the file from submission to approval: respond to lender requests, provide supporting documents and keep the file moving

• Chase outstanding documents and signatures from clients

• Track conditional and formal approvals, loan documents and settlement dates

• Liaise with lenders, clients, conveyancers and solicitors to get each file to settlement

• Keep the CRM and file notes up to date so the broker can see the status of every deal



What we're looking for:

• Minimum 2 years' experience as a loan processor in an Australian mortgage brokerage (essential)

• Experience lodging through ApplyOnline and working with Australian lenders

• Experience with a broker CRM (MyCRM preferred)

• Settlement experience is a plus, but we'll train the right person

• Strong written and spoken English, confident communicating with Australian clients and lenders

• High attention to detail and able to follow a written process exactly

• Reliable internet and a quiet home workspace



Please only apply if you have at least 2 years' experience as a loan processor in an Australian mortgage brokerage.



Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday, 7:00am to 3:00pm Philippine time (9:00am to 5:00pm AEST)

Pay: ₱55,000 to ₱65,000 per month, depending on experience, plus 13th-month pay and statutory benefits from day one



Employment: Engaged as an employee through our Employer of Record in the Philippines



Start: Within 2 weeks of offer acceptance



To apply, send your CV and answer the following questions:



 1. How many years have you worked in Australian mortgage processing?

 2. Have you used MyCRM or other broker CRM software?If yes, explain what you can do independently in it.

 3. Have you used ApplyOnline?

 4. Can you manage a residential loan from application through to settlement?

 5. Which Australian lenders have you worked with?

 6. What types of loans have you processed: Purchase, Refinance, Construction, Investment, SMSF, Company/Trust?

 7. Approximately how many active loan files have you managed at one time?

 8. What was your most recent monthly salary?

 9. What is your expected monthly salary in PHP?

 10. When can you start?

title: Creative Strategist & Ecom Ad Copywriter
description:
We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand looking for a talented Creative Strategist & Copywriter who understands what makes people stop scrolling, pay attention, and buy.



This isn't a typical copywriting job where you simply follow instructions.



You'll have the freedom to research, develop creative angles, and turn customer insights into winning ad concepts. We value great ideas, independent thinking, and measurable results.



-Compensation & Benefits-



$1,000/month guaranteed base salary



- Performance bonuses of up to $600 per winning ad concept

- Potential earnings of $2,000–$3,000/month based on results

- Long-term, stable, full-time opportunity

- Work remotely with a fast-growing e-commerce brand

- Creative freedom and ownership of your work

- Opportunity to grow as the brand scales



-What You'll Be Doing-



You'll be responsible for developing 30 video ad concepts and 10 static ad concepts per month. Your responsibilities include:



- Researching target audiences, competitors, and emerging market trends

- Discovering powerful customer pain points, desires, and buying motivations

- Developing compelling hooks, unique angles, and persuasive ad concepts

- Writing conversion-focused video ad scripts and static ad copy

- Creating easy-to-follow creative briefs for our production team

- Using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and writing

- Studying ad performance to continuously improve future concepts

-Who We're Looking For-



We're looking for someone who:



- Has experience writing or conceptualizing successful e-commerce ads

- Understands direct-response marketing and consumer psychology

- Knows how to craft hooks that grab attention within seconds

- Can research products and uncover fresh advertising angles

- Understands advertising metrics and performance

- Is comfortable using AI tools

- Can work independently without constant supervision

- Communicates clearly in English (B1 or higher)

We care more about your ability to develop winning ads than impressive job titles or fancy credentials.



-Why Join Us-



We believe great creative strategists should be rewarded when their ideas generate results.



You'll receive a guaranteed monthly salary, have meaningful creative ownership, and earn additional bonuses when your concepts succeed.



If you're someone who enjoys understanding customers, studying winning ads, and figuring out why people buy, you'll feel right at home.

Start your application with "I write killer ads." so we know you've read the job description. Then answer these questions:

- What's your process for writing an ad that converts?

We're reviewing applications immediately and looking to hire ASAP. If you love creating ads that sell, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor for Meta Ads (TikTok B-roll + AI Voiceover)
description:
About us

We are a fast-growing DTC footwear brand in the problem-solving space. Our footwear solves real, everyday problems, so our ads are not fashion or lifestyle looks: they are problem-and-solution ads. We run paid ads on
 and Instagram and we are looking for a full-time video editor to join us long term on a monthly salary.



Please read this first

Our ads are TikTok B-roll clips cut to an AI voiceover, with only a little AI-generated footage blended in where it is needed (it depends on the brief). We do not make fully AI-generated videos.



How our ads are made



We send you a script with three hooks and an example video: an ad we have swiped and reverse engineered.

You add the AI voiceover from the script.

You find and download real B-roll clips from TikTok that match each line of the script. Every clip must be sourced by you from TikTok. No stock footage (Pexels, Storyblocks, Envato or similar) is allowed.

For product shots, you use our product B-roll bank. If a product shot you need is not in the bank, you generate it yourself in Google Flow.

You follow the example video’s format and editing style exactly, and edit it all into a fast, scroll-stopping ad of 30 to 90 seconds, with captions and on-screen text, and export three versions (one per hook).



Formats you will edit



Voiceover montage ads (B-roll cut to a voiceover)

Listicle ads (“5 reasons...” style)

POV and story-style ads

Product demos and side-by-side comparisons



What we are looking for



Proven experience making this type of ad: B-roll cut to a voiceover, for
, Instagram or TikTok

Experience editing problem-and-solution ads for footwear brands

You must be able to reverse engineer ads: break down an example video’s structure, pacing and editing style

You must be able to create an ad from an example video we have swiped and reverse engineered, following the exact same format and editing style

A strong understanding of hook rate, thumb-stop and what makes an ad convert

Strong at finding the right TikTok clips quickly, so every line of the script has a matching visual

Good instincts for hooks, pacing and keeping people watching

Clean captions and on-screen text

Proficient in CapCut

Able to use Google Flow to generate product clips when needed

Reliable, organised, and good at following a brief and our file naming

Comfortable making several ads a week and fast revisions



How to apply



Start your application with the words “TikTok B-roll” so we know you read this post.

Send 2 to 3 ads you edited that use TikTok or UGC B-roll with a voiceover (links please). Fully AI-generated videos will not be considered.

Tell us how you find and download TikTok clips for an ad.

Tell us your experience with Google Flow.

Your expected monthly salary and how many 60-second ads you can deliver per week.

title: Executive Assistant & Multi-Business Operations Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a highly organized, experienced, dependable, resourceful, and proactive Executive Assistant & Multi-Business Operations Coordinator to provide comprehensive executive, administrative, and operational support to the owner of multiple businesses based in the United States and the U.S. Virgin Islands.



Our businesses operate across behavioral health and social services, restaurants, hospitality, catering, private events, business consulting, media, entertainment, and creative ventures.



This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant position limited to answering
s, scheduling appointments, or completing basic administrative tasks.



We need someone who can serve as a reliable extension of the business owner, independently manage responsibilities, anticipate needs, coordinate activities across multiple businesses, and ensure that important tasks are completed accurately and on time.



The ideal candidate takes initiative, solves problems, communicates proactively, follows through consistently, and does not require constant reminders or supervision.



Key Responsibilities



1. Executive & Administrative Support



Manage executive calendars, appointments, meetings, schedules, and deadlines.



Monitor and organize
s, correspondence, and administrative communications.



Draft professional
s, letters, reports, presentations, and business documents.



Track outstanding requests, responses, assignments, and follow-up items.



Organize electronic files, business records, contracts, and administrative documentation.



Coordinate meetings and prepare agendas, notes, and action-item summaries.



Research business needs, gather information, and recommend practical solutions.



Assist with personal executive administrative responsibilities when appropriate.



Establish organized systems that improve efficiency and reduce the business owner's administrative workload.



2. Multi-Business Operations & Project Coordination



Coordinate administrative activities across multiple businesses and industries.



Maintain project trackers, task lists, operational calendars, and deadline reminders.



Follow up with Workers, contractors, vendors, and business partners regarding outstanding responsibilities.



Monitor progress on assigned projects and provide regular updates.



Assist with developing and implementing administrative procedures, workflows, and standard operating procedures.



Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend improvements.



Coordinate information between business departments and designated personnel.



Assist with business registrations, renewals, applications, and administrative compliance deadlines.



Support the implementation and maintenance of business management software and digital systems.



Help ensure business operations remain organized, efficient, and accountable.



3. Worker, Contractor & Payroll Administration



Coordinate Worker and contractor scheduling, availability, and administrative communications.



Collect, organize, and review timesheets, attendance records, and payroll-related documentation.



Follow up on missing timesheets, incomplete records, and outstanding payroll submissions.



Coordinate with supervisors and management to verify approved hours, schedules, and payroll adjustments.



Track payroll deadlines and ensure required information is submitted to the Bookkeeper on time.



Organize approved mileage, reimbursements, and other compensation-related documentation.



Assist with resolving Worker and contractor payroll inquiries and discrepancies.



Maintain organized Worker and contractor administrative records.



Assist with recruitment, applicant screening, interview scheduling, onboarding, orientation, and training coordination.



Track required onboarding documents, acknowledgments, and outstanding administrative requirements.



Payroll calculations, financial reconciliations, and accounting reports will primarily be handled by the Bookkeeper. Management retains final payroll approval authority.



4. Behavioral Health & Healthcare Administration



Assist with administrative coordination for behavioral health and social service programs.



Monitor service authorizations, expiration dates, billing deadlines, and outstanding administrative requirements.



Track documentation submissions, Provider notes, and missing administrative records.



Coordinate with Providers, case managers, authorized agencies, and internal personnel as directed.



Assist with preparing administrative reports, correspondence, and service-related documentation.



Maintain organized and confidential client and Provider records.



Track outstanding invoices, reimbursements, and payment follow-ups in coordination with the Bookkeeper.



Assist with Provider scheduling, availability, onboarding, and administrative compliance.



Follow up on unresolved administrative matters to help prevent delays in services or billing.



All responsibilities involving confidential healthcare information must follow applicable privacy, security, and organizational requirements. Clinical decisions and regulated approvals remain with authorized professionals.



5. Restaurant, Hospitality, Catering & Event Support



Provide administrative support for restaurant, bar, lounge, catering, and hospitality operations.



Coordinate with restaurant management, supervisors, and operational personnel.



Assist with tracking vendor communications, orders, purchasing requests, and administrative records.



Support event inquiries, private bookings, catering requests, and related follow-ups when needed.



Coordinate administrative tasks with designated event and marketing personnel.



Assist with updating menus, business information, websites, and digital platforms.



Track outstanding operational tasks and ensure appropriate follow-up.



Assist with organizing operational reports, schedules, and internal communications.



6. Business Development, Research & Special Projects



Research business opportunities, partnerships, vendors, and service providers.



Assist with preparing applications, proposals, presentations, and business correspondence.



Support administrative activities related to consulting, media, podcasting, entertainment, and creative ventures.



Coordinate deadlines and supporting documentation for ongoing business projects.



Research software, systems, and tools that can improve productivity and efficiency.



Assist with organizing customer, vendor, and business contact information.



Support other executive and operational projects as assigned.



7. Financial Administrative Coordination



Although a separate Bookkeeper will manage primary accounting responsibilities, the Executive Assistant will help ensure financial information is collected, organized, and submitted on time.



Responsibilities include:



Collecting and organizing invoices, receipts, and supporting documentation.



Tracking administrative payment deadlines and outstanding financial requests.



Following up on unpaid invoices and outstanding receivables as directed.



Coordinating with the Bookkeeper regarding missing financial records.



Assisting with vendor communications and payment-related inquiries.



Monitoring completion of assigned financial administrative tasks.



Helping maintain organized financial documentation across multiple businesses.



This position does not require independently preparing financial statements, performing bank reconciliations, or managing full-cycle bookkeeping.



Required Qualifications



Minimum 3 years of relevant executive assistance, administrative coordination, or business operations experience.



Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines.



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving abilities.



Experience coordinating with multiple individuals, departments, or businesses.



Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office,
, calendars, and spreadsheets.



Comfortable learning new software, business platforms, and administrative systems.



Ability to work independently and proactively without constant supervision.



Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.



Professional judgment, discretion, integrity, and confidentiality.



Reliable internet connection, computer, and remote working environment.



Availability to participate in scheduled meetings during U.S. business hours.



Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience directly supporting a CEO, business owner, or senior executive.



Experience supporting multiple businesses or departments simultaneously.



Healthcare, behavioral health, or social services administrative experience.



Restaurant, hospitality, catering, or event operations experience.



Experience coordinating Workers, contractors, recruitment, or onboarding.



Familiarity with payroll administration and timesheet coordination.



Experience with project management software, CRM platforms, and workflow automation.



Basic website administration and digital business management experience.



Experience with administrative billing, invoicing, or accounts receivable follow-up.



Schedule & Compensation



Position Type: Remote, part-time independent contractor.



Starting Rate: $3.75–$5.00 USD per hour, based on qualifications, experience, and demonstrated capabilities.



Initial Workload: Approximately 5–10 hours per week.



Schedule: Flexible, but applicants must be available for scheduled meetings, timely communication, and agreed-upon responsibilities during U.S. business hours when necessary.



Start Date: Immediate, following successful selection and onboarding.



Additional hours, responsibilities, and compensation adjustments may become available based on demonstrated performance, reliability, business growth, and operational needs.



Performance & Accountability Expectations



We are looking for someone who can genuinely reduce the administrative burden of managing multiple businesses.



The successful candidate must be able to:



Take ownership of assigned responsibilities.



Anticipate needs and identify priorities.



Communicate proactively without waiting to be asked.



Follow through on assignments until they are completed.



Identify problems and present possible solutions.



Maintain accurate records and organized systems.



Meet deadlines consistently.



Provide clear updates on completed, pending, and overdue tasks.



Handle confidential business information professionally.



Adapt quickly as business priorities change.



We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions. We need a proactive professional who can help keep multiple businesses moving forward.



Required Application Questions



Please answer all questions when submitting your application.



How many years of executive assistance, administrative coordination, or business operations experience do you have? Describe the executives or businesses you supported.



Have you supported multiple businesses, executives, or departments simultaneously? Explain how you organized competing priorities.



Describe a situation where you identified a problem, took initiative, and resolved it without being instructed.



What experience do you have managing executive calendars, correspondence, deadlines, and follow-up responsibilities?



Have you coordinated Workers, contractors, schedules, timesheets, payroll documentation, or onboarding activities? Please explain.



Do you have experience in healthcare, behavioral health, social services, restaurants, hospitality, catering, or event operations?



Which software platforms, project management tools, CRM systems, and administrative applications have you used?



How would you organize and manage outstanding tasks across several businesses while ensuring that nothing is overlooked?



What is your expected hourly rate within the advertised range of $3.75–$5.00 USD? What is your weekly availability, and when could you begin?



Please provide an example of an executive report, administrative tracker, project management system, or workflow you personally created or managed, with confidential information removed.



Selection & Onboarding Process



Qualified applicants will be invited to participate in individual interviews and, where appropriate, practical skills assessments.



Selected candidates will receive an offer outlining their position, compensation, responsibilities, and working arrangements.



Following acceptance of the offer and completion of the required onboarding documentation, newly hired contractors will participate in a mandatory group orientation.



Group orientation will cover company expectations, communication procedures, reporting requirements, administrative systems, confidentiality, accountability, and standards applicable to the position.



We are seeking a long-term professional relationship with someone who demonstrates initiative, accountability, strong communication, and a genuine commitment to helping our businesses operate more effectively.



If you are an experienced, proactive, and resourceful Executive Assistant who thrives in a fast-paced, multi-business environment, we encourage you to apply.

title: CUSTOMER SUPPORT AGENT FOR SHOPIFY BRAND
description:
Apex Follix is looking for a part-time Customer Support Agent to join our team!

As our Customer Support Agent, you will be responsible for handling every customer interaction that our automations can’t solve, resolving tickets from start to finish, and making sure every customer has a world-class experience. You will turn frustrated customers into brand advocates by providing fast, empathetic, and effective solutions.

We are looking to hire someone with experience in e-commerce customer support. The ideal candidate has prior experience with DTC brands, knows how to handle disputes and difficult cases, and can think for themselves. You see a problem, you solve it, and you tell us how to stop it from happening again.

Who are we?

 At Apex Follix, we are transforming the lives of people dealing with hair thinning and hair loss. We sell a hair growth and scalp-health system built around a micro-infusion serum treatment, along with complementary products. We serve thousands of customers, mainly in Mexico, with a core team of just 2 people. We’ve automated most of our operations with AI workflows, which lets a very small team do the work of a much bigger one. We are looking to continue our growth by finding a great customer support agent to play a pivotal role in scaling!

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less, and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following four core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better every day. We love learning. Every problem is an opportunity to grow, and if you have ideas to simplify how we work, we want to hear them.

If you want a job where you wait for instructions, this isn’t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and grow with a brand on its way to $20M+ a year... If you want to work with a small group of smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or micromanagement, where your ideas actually get implemented, then you’ve come to the right place.

If you wish to apply, mention the word “PELO” in your application message.

Key Objectives

 Resolve every ticket that reaches you during your check-ins (morning, afternoon, and night) while maintaining a friendly, helpful tone.

 Apply problem-solving principles to resolve shipping, product, and order issues autonomously.

 Operate with a high degree of autonomy, without needing hand-holding.

 Communicate with our supplier to make sure orders ship on time and logistics run without delays.

 Identify where our AI automations fall short and give clear direction on how to improve them. Implementing those improvements yourself is highly valued.

 Bring ideas that simplify our processes.

Requirements

 Fully remote.

 Fluent in English (written). All internal communication is in English.

 Proven experience in Customer Support for e-commerce brands, ideally DTC.

 Experience with Shopify.

 Experience handling disputes and chargebacks.

 Available for three short check-ins per day (morning, afternoon, and night), including weekends when needed.

 Spanish is not required but is highly appreciated, since most of our customers speak it. Translation tools are fine if your replies sound natural.

 Experience with AI tools, especially Claude / Claude Code, is a plus.

 Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.

KPI’S you will own

 Zero open tickets at the end of each check-in.

Accountabilities

 Resolve customer tickets from start to finish.

 Process refunds, replacements, and order cancellations according to company policy.

 Handle payment disputes and chargebacks, gathering the right evidence and responding on time.

 Follow up with our supplier on shipments and flag any delays before customers notice them.

 Proactively identify and report “fire” situations (e.g., website bugs, mass shipping delays).

This Role Is Not For You If

 You need step-by-step instructions to get things done. This is a high-autonomy role where you’re trusted to make decisions.

 You are a perfectionist who spends 20 minutes drafting a single reply. Efficiency, templates, and quick personalization are key.

 You struggle with fast-paced changes. Our policies, products, and automations can change overnight, and you must be able to adapt without frustration.

 You solve the same problem twice instead of suggesting how to fix it for good.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

 To apply, please submit a video introduction along with your CV.

If you’re a strong match, we’ll invite you to a single interview covering both technical ability (via mock tickets) and culture fit.

 We move quickly and aim to hire the right candidate within 5–7 days. We pride ourselves on timely responses. We won’t leave you hanging.

Salary Expectation

 USD $7 – $9.50 per hour (approx. 1 hour per day, split across 3 check-ins), based on experience and expertise.

I want my Instagram to feel like a beautifully curated digital journal — elegant, feminine, modern, aesthetically pleasing, and authentic.



I’m not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together. I want a creative partner who understands visual storytelling, has a good eye for aesthetics, and can transform everyday photos and videos into engaging Instagram content.



I will provide raw photos, videos, and information about upcoming experiences. Your responsibility will be to turn that material into polished, creative content.



Responsibilities



Instagram Reels & Video Editing



* Edit approximately 1–3 high-quality Instagram reels per month.

* Turn raw travel, lifestyle, restaurant, and everyday footage into engaging short-form videos.

* Add aesthetically pleasing transitions, trending audio, captions, and text overlays.

* Create storytelling reels, travel diaries, lifestyle montages, and occasional voiceover videos.

Instagram Posts & Stories



* Create attractive photo carousels and Instagram posts.

Content Planning & Creative Direction

Instagram Scheduling & Publishing

* Cinematic travel diaries and mini vlogs

* Soft, aesthetically pleasing typography

* Authentic storytelling with a polished finish
