title: Operations Manager (Supply Chain & Subscriptions) – E-Commerce Subscription Brand
description:
ABOUT US

We are a fast-growing e-commerce company running a scaling subscription brand in the health & wellness space, selling across the Big 5 English-speaking markets. We are a lean, fully remote international team of ~15 people led by two founders, with dedicated departments for creative, media buying, CRO,
, customer service and supply chain, and clear KPIs and bonus structures across the team.



We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to own our back-end: supply chain, subscriptions and retention, customer service oversight, payment operations and finance coordination. The goal is simple: the back-end runs smoothly without the founders having to chase it.



THE ROLE

You report directly to the two founders and act as the operational backbone of the company. Our product is manufactured in China and shipped worldwide through 3PL partners. You make sure we never run out of stock, orders arrive fast, costs go down, customers stay subscribed, and the numbers are organized and reported on time.



Supply chain and retention are the key priorities of this role. Everything else supports those two.



This is a hands-on management role for someone independent. You compile the data, build the reports and flag the problems yourself, before anyone has to ask. The role is task-based, not clock-based: we care about outcomes and clear communication, not about you being online around the clock.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Supply chain (key priority)

- Forecast stock based on daily order and subscription rebill volume, keeping a safety buffer and planning around production lead times and factory holidays

- Place and track bulk orders with our manufacturer: timelines, packaging, quality follow-ups

- Check the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) and quality documents for every production batch

- Manage and negotiate with our 3PLs: shipping lines, delivery times per market, rates and payment terms

- Work on lowering COGS and shipping cost per order without hurting delivery times

- Work closely with our shipping customer service agent, who tracks shipments daily, to validate real delivery times against what our 3PLs promise



Subscriptions & retention (key priority)

- Own the operational side of our subscription program: rebills, churn, cancellation and save rates

- Collect and understand customer feedback (tickets, cancellation reasons, surveys) and turn it into clear actions that improve retention

- Spot how shipping, product and service issues affect cancellations, and fix the root cause



Customer service oversight

- We have a Customer Service Manager in place who runs the team day to day; you oversee the department

- Set clear KPIs, track them, and run the monthly reporting and bonus calculations

- Highlight ongoing issues to the founders early, with a proposed solution



Chargebacks & payment operations

- Monitor chargeback rates and understand what is driving them

- Keep payment processor requirements and compliance follow-ups organized

- Coordinate with customer service so disputes are prevented and handled on time



Finance coordination

- Help coordinate with our finance team: supplier and 3PL invoices, payment schedules, cost tracking

- Make sure our bookkeeper and accounting partner have what they need, complete and on time

- Report weekly to the founders on the key back-end numbers: stock cover, delivery times, COGS, churn, chargebacks, CS performance



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Experience in a subscription-based e-commerce business is required: you understand recurring billing, rebill cycles, churn and retention

- Proven supply chain experience: inventory forecasting, manufacturer orders and 3PL management for a physical product

- Working knowledge of chargebacks and payment operations: you understand how disputes work and what keeps a merchant account healthy

- 3+ years in an operations, supply chain or team lead role in e-commerce / DTC

- Experience with supplements or other regulated health products is a plus

- Experience with China-based suppliers and international shipping is a plus

- Experience with Loop Subscriptions is a plus

- Strong with numbers and spreadsheets: you enjoy compiling data and building reports

- Confident negotiator, firm but fair with suppliers and partners

- Independent and proactive: you report on your own initiative, without the founders constantly following up

- You take the job seriously and are looking for a long-term role

- Excellent written English; most of our communication is async and in writing

- Comfortable with Shopify, Slack, ClickUp (or similar) and Google Workspace

- Available during Asian timezone working hours



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, long-term remote position with a stable but flexible weekly schedule

- $1,500–$2,000 USD per month, based on experience, plus a performance bonus structure with clear, measurable targets

- Real responsibility and direct access to the founders

- Room to grow with the brand as we scale

- A professional, no-nonsense team culture: clear KPIs, honest feedback, no micromanagement



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with:

1. Your prior work experience: the subscription brand(s) you worked with, your role, and what you owned.

2. One example of a supply chain problem you fixed (stockout, slow delivery, supplier issue, high costs): what was broken, what did you change, and what was the measurable result?

3. One report or dashboard you built on your own initiative, and what decision it led to.

4. Your available hours and expected monthly salary.



A short Loom video or any other introduction of yourself is appreciated.



Start your application with the word "Mango" so we know you read the full post. Applications without the four points above will not be considered.

title: Bookkeeper & Financial Administrative Assistant
description:
We are seeking a dependable, highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Bookkeeper & Financial Administrative Assistant to support the financial operations of multiple businesses operating in the United States and the U.S. Virgin Islands.



Our businesses operate across several industries, including behavioral health and social services, restaurants, hospitality, catering, events, consulting, and creative ventures.



We are looking for someone who understands bookkeeping principles, has practical experience working with financial records, and can independently maintain accurate financial information while helping improve existing accounting processes.



This position requires someone who is comfortable working with numbers, identifying discrepancies, meeting deadlines, and maintaining strict confidentiality.



We are particularly interested in candidates with hands-on experience in payroll processing, bank reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial reporting.



Key Responsibilities



1. Bookkeeping & Financial Record Management



Maintain accurate and organized bookkeeping records for multiple businesses.



Record, review, and categorize income, expenses, deposits, and financial transactions.



Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, and other financial accounts.



Identify and investigate missing transactions, duplicate entries, and discrepancies.



Organize receipts, invoices, statements, and supporting financial documentation.



Assist with bringing outstanding bookkeeping records current and resolving existing backlogs.



Maintain separate financial records and accounting documentation for each business.



Help establish and maintain consistent bookkeeping procedures and internal financial controls.



2. Payroll Processing & Administration



Prepare and calculate payroll for Workers and contractors across multiple businesses.



Review approved timesheets, hours worked, compensation rates, and payroll adjustments.



Calculate gross compensation, approved reimbursements, mileage, and applicable deductions.



Verify payroll calculations for accuracy and identify discrepancies before submission.



Prepare payroll registers, payment summaries, and supporting documentation.



Assist with processing payroll through designated payroll and accounting platforms.



Maintain accurate payroll records, payment histories, and compensation documentation.



Reconcile payroll payments against bank transactions and accounting records.



Track payroll schedules and deadlines to ensure timely processing.



Coordinate with the Executive Assistant and management to resolve missing documentation, incorrect hours, and payroll discrepancies.



Assist with preparing payroll-related reports and documentation for accountants and other authorized professionals.



All payroll payments must be reviewed and approved by management before funds are released.



3. Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



Maintain accurate records of outstanding customer invoices and vendor bills.



Track accounts payable, due dates, recurring expenses, and financial obligations.



Monitor accounts receivable and identify overdue or outstanding payments.



Prepare accounts receivable aging reports and payment tracking summaries.



Assist with invoicing, payment reminders, and collections follow-up.



Reconcile payments received against outstanding invoices.



Identify missing payments, discrepancies, duplicate invoices, and billing errors.



Coordinate with the Executive Assistant and management regarding outstanding financial matters.



Maintain accurate records of vendor payments, reimbursements, and financial commitments.



4. Financial Reporting, Budgeting & Cash Flow



Prepare and maintain monthly financial summaries and bookkeeping reports.



Assist with preparing profit-and-loss statements and balance sheets.



Track business income, expenses, and operating costs.



Monitor cash flow and identify upcoming financial obligations.



Assist with preparing monthly and annual operating budgets.



Track actual expenses against established budgets.



Help identify unnecessary expenses, financial discrepancies, and opportunities for improved financial efficiency.



Prepare organized financial information for management review.



Assist with maintaining records needed for accountants, tax professionals, and financial reporting.



5. Multi-Business Financial Coordination



Maintain clear financial separation between multiple businesses.



Organize and track financial documents, invoices, receipts, and statements.



Coordinate with management and the Executive Assistant to obtain missing financial information.



Support financial tracking for restaurant operations, hospitality services, catering, events, and healthcare-related businesses.



Assist with tracking service-related invoices, payments, and outstanding reimbursements.



Maintain accurate records of business-related purchases, vendor transactions, and operating expenses.



Recommend improvements to bookkeeping workflows, reporting systems, and financial organization.



6. Administrative Support & Accountability



Maintain organized digital financial files and spreadsheets.



Prepare financial updates and communicate outstanding issues to management.



Monitor assigned deadlines and complete tasks without repeated reminders.



Provide regular updates on completed work, pending items, and identified discrepancies.



Maintain confidentiality of financial, business, Worker, and client information.



Follow established company procedures and applicable data protection requirements.



Communicate proactively when information is missing or clarification is needed.



Required Qualifications



Previous hands-on bookkeeping, accounting support, financial auditing, or reconciliation experience.



Experience preparing or reviewing payroll calculations and related documentation.



Working knowledge of bank and credit card reconciliations.



Understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable.



Familiarity with basic financial statements, including profit-and-loss statements and balance sheets.



Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.



Experience with QuickBooks Online, Xero, or comparable accounting software.



Strong mathematical, analytical, and organizational skills.



Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify financial discrepancies.



Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and maintain accurate records.



Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional remote working environment.



High level of integrity, accountability, and confidentiality.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience supporting multiple businesses or clients.



Experience with U.S.-based businesses or accounting procedures.



Payroll processing experience for U.S. businesses.



Experience with restaurant, hospitality, or healthcare financial operations.



Familiarity with payment processors, point-of-sale systems, and business invoicing platforms.



Experience resolving bookkeeping backlogs or correcting financial discrepancies.



Experience with budgeting, cash flow reporting, and financial forecasting.



Experience with contractor payments and reimbursement tracking.



Schedule & Compensation



Position Type: Remote, part-time independent contractor.



Starting Rate: $3.00–$4.50 USD per hour, based on qualifications and experience.



Initial Workload: Approximately 5–8 hours per week.



Schedule: Flexible, with the ability to attend scheduled meetings and meet payroll and financial reporting deadlines.



Start Date: Immediate, following successful selection and onboarding.



Additional hours, responsibilities, and compensation adjustments may become available based on demonstrated performance, reliability, and business needs.



What We Are Looking For



We are not simply looking for someone to enter transactions into a spreadsheet.



We need someone who understands the importance of accurate financial records, can recognize discrepancies, takes initiative, and follows through on financial responsibilities without constant supervision.



The ideal candidate will be:



Accurate and detail-oriented.



Honest, trustworthy, and dependable.



Comfortable handling confidential financial information.



Organized and capable of supporting multiple businesses.



Proactive in identifying problems and recommending solutions.



Willing to learn new systems and improve existing processes.



Consistent in meeting payroll, reconciliation, and reporting deadlines.



Interested in building a long-term professional working relationship.



Required Application Questions



Please answer all questions when submitting your application.



How many years of hands-on bookkeeping, accounting, or financial reconciliation experience do you have? Briefly describe your responsibilities.



Which accounting platforms have you used professionally? Please specify your experience with QuickBooks Online, Xero, or other software.



Have you independently completed bank and credit card reconciliations? Describe your process.



Describe your direct payroll experience. Have you calculated payroll, reviewed timesheets, processed payments, managed reimbursements, or reconciled payroll records? Which systems have you used?



Have you managed accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoicing, overdue payments, and collections?



Have you prepared profit-and-loss statements, balance sheets, cash flow summaries, or operating budgets? Please explain your level of involvement.

title: Government Contracts & Business Development Specialist
description:
Job Description

Northline Security Services is a Minnesota-based security company seeking an experienced, proactive, and results-driven Government Contracts & Business Development Specialist to help us identify, pursue, and secure new security service contracts.

This is NOT a traditional virtual assistant or basic lead generation position.

We need someone who can independently research opportunities, identify potential clients, navigate government procurement websites, prepare and submit contract proposals, and consistently conduct outreach to generate new business.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative rather than waiting to be assigned tasks.

Our goal is to build a consistent pipeline of new security contracts throughout Minnesota.



Key Responsibilities

1. Government Contract Research & Bidding

- Monitor federal, Minnesota state, county, city, school district, and public housing procurement websites.

- Identify open RFPs, RFQs, government bids, and security service contracting opportunities.

- Research upcoming contracts, expiring agreements, and potential rebidding opportunities.

- Review bid requirements and determine whether our company qualifies.

- Present qualified opportunities to management for approval.

- Once approved, independently prepare complete proposals using company documents stored in Google Drive.

- Complete required applications, forms, and supporting documentation.

- Submit proposals through government procurement portals after receiving final management approval.

- Track deadlines, submission statuses, and follow-up requirements.

- Maintain an organized database of government contracting opportunities.



2. Business Development & Client Outreach

This is one of the most important responsibilities of the position.

We need someone who actively searches for new business opportunities rather than simply generating contact lists.

Responsibilities include:

- Identify Minnesota businesses and organizations that may need security services.

- Research apartment complexes, property management companies, construction sites, commercial properties, schools, healthcare facilities, warehouses, and other potential clients.

- Identify decision-makers responsible for hiring security companies.

- Conduct personalized
 outreach and professional phone calls.

- Contact property managers, facility directors, business owners, and purchasing departments.

- Research upcoming projects, new developments, and organizations potentially looking to change security providers.

- Consistently follow up with potential clients.

- Schedule qualified appointments with interested organizations.

- Identify opportunities that competitors or other security companies may not be pursuing.

- Develop strategies to consistently generate new contracting opportunities.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply scrapes leads or sends hundreds of generic
s.

We need someone who can research organizations, identify real opportunities, establish contact with decision-makers, and help turn those opportunities into paying contracts.



3. CRM & Opportunity Management

- Maintain an organized pipeline of potential customers and government contracts.

- Track outreach activity, follow-ups, appointments, and bid deadlines.

- Monitor previously awarded contracts for upcoming renewals.

- Provide weekly reports showing opportunities identified, bids submitted, outreach completed, and meetings scheduled.

- Proactively recommend new industries, organizations, and opportunities to pursue.

Required Qualifications

- Previous experience with government contracting, procurement research, RFP submissions, or proposal writing.

- Experience conducting B2B business development and outreach.

- Familiarity with U.S. government procurement processes.

- Strong research and problem-solving abilities.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Experience preparing professional business proposals.

- Ability to independently identify and pursue business opportunities.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Experience with Google Workspace and CRM software.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with U.S.-based companies.

- Experience using SAM.gov or state government procurement portals.

- Previous experience submitting government contract bids.

- Experience in the security, staffing, construction, or facility management industries.

- Experience with cold calling,
 outreach, and appointment setting.

- Familiarity with Minnesota businesses and government agencies.



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

Proactive: You independently find opportunities instead of waiting for instructions.

Resourceful: You know how to research unfamiliar websites, find decision-makers, and identify potential contracts.

Results-Oriented: Your goal is to help our company acquire new contracts, not simply complete assigned tasks.

Organized: You can manage multiple bids, deadlines, prospects, and follow-ups simultaneously.

Independent: You can take an approved opportunity from initial research through proposal preparation and submission.

Growth-Minded: You want to become a long-term part of a growing company.



Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by:

- Qualified government contracting opportunities identified.

- Approved proposals successfully prepared and submitted.

- Quality of potential clients identified.

- Consistency and effectiveness of outreach.

- Qualified appointments scheduled.

- Progress toward securing new security service contracts.

- Accuracy and organization of the contracting pipeline.



We value meaningful results over simply completing a high volume of tasks.



Schedule & Compensation

- Starting at approximately 20 hours per week.

- Flexible schedule with some availability during U.S. Central Time business hours.

- Initial 30-day evaluation period.

- Opportunity to transition into a full-time, long-term position based on performance.

- Compensation negotiable depending on experience and qualifications.



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

1. Your resume and relevant work experience.

2. Details of your experience researching or submitting U.S. government contracts.

3. Examples of procurement websites you have used.

4. Your experience with B2B outreach and generating business opportunities.

5. A brief explanation of how you would find security service contracts for a Minnesota-based company.

6. Your expected hourly rate.

7. Your weekly availability.

8.
 
 with your info



Start your application with "Northline Contracts" to confirm you have read the entire job description.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical assessment to demonstrate their ability to identify legitimate contracting opportunities and potential customers.

We are seeking someone who can take ownership of business development and become a valuable long-term member of Northline Security Services.

title: Amazon PPC Content Writer & LinkedIn Manager (US Amazon brands), daily posts
description:
About us

PPC Jumpstart is a small Amazon PPC agency based in Surrey, BC, Canada. Our clients are US brands selling on Amazon, mostly founders and owners doing $500K+ a year on Amazon. We manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display, and our job is simple to say: grow their sales while keeping ACOS within their target.



I'm Vadim, the founder. I post on LinkedIn to reach US brand owners. I want one person to own a daily LinkedIn post on my profile: short, sharp, useful Amazon PPC posts that a busy US owner reads in 30 seconds and thinks "I should check that in my account."



The goal is to make my name the one US brand owners think of for Amazon PPC. Reach matters, but every post has to be useful to a business owner, not just to other PPC people. No "comment X for the PDF" tricks.



What you'll do every day

- Write one LinkedIn post a day (Mon–Fri) in our house template: a short, contrarian hook, one-line paragraphs, one simple comparison, one named Amazon report or tool, and a clear "what this means for your sales / ACOS / margin."

- Design the graphic for each post (single 4:5 image, sometimes a short carousel) in our brand style: navy, gold and our logo. Templates are provided.

- Find post ideas in Amazon Ads updates, my weekly interview notes, client results I give you permission to use, and my Loom audit recordings.

- Score every draft against our checklist before you send it to me. Below the bar, rewrite it.

- Send drafts to me for approval. Nothing goes live without my approval.

- Get approved posts live at 8:00 AM Pacific Time (US), and add the first comment with my booking link right after.

- Seven days after each post, open the post analytics and log where viewers came from (country/city) in our tracking sheet.

- Send a short Monday report: what went out, what scored well, which posts reached US viewers.



Must-haves

- Amazon Ads console fluency. You have worked inside Amazon Ads (as a PPC specialist, VA or account manager). You know Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display, and you can read a search term report without help.

- You understand ACOS vs TACoS and can explain to a business owner why the lowest ACOS isn't always the best result.

- Strong US-business English. Short sentences, plain words, no filler. You can write for a US founder, not for other PPC specialists.

- Canva or Figma. You can follow a brand template exactly: colours, logo, spacing.

- LinkedIn native. You know how LinkedIn posts, carousels (PDF), first comments, scheduling and post analytics work.

- Reliable during US Pacific mornings. Posts go live at 8:00 AM PT, every weekday.

- Comfortable taking direct edits and rewriting fast.



Nice-to-haves

- You've ghostwritten LinkedIn posts for a founder or agency.

- Familiar with Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, Business Reports, placement reports, Manage Your Experiments.

- You follow Amazon seller news and can explain an Amazon change in 3 lines.

- Basic video editing (short captioned clips).

- Google Sheets for simple logs.



Hours

- Must overlap with US Pacific mornings. Posts go live at 8:00 AM PT Mon–Fri.

- Philippines time: 8:00 AM PT = 11:00 PM PHT until Nov 1, 2026, then 12:00 AM (midnight) PHT after US clocks change (Nov 1 to March).

- Flexible part-time schedule. Time is tracked in Time Doctor.

- About 15–20 hrs/week to start.



Pay

$7–11 USD per hour, depending on skill and trial results. Hours tracked in Time Doctor.



Paid trial

Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial, about 3 hours of work at your hourly rate, 48 hours to send it back. You'll write 3 posts from raw notes we give you and design 1 graphic. We'll pay for the trial whether or not we hire you.



How to apply

1. Put MARGIN FIRST as the first line of your application. Applications without it won't be read.

2. Answer in your own words, no AI (we'll know):

   - In 3 sentences, explain to a US brand owner why a low ACOS can hurt their sales.

   - What is the difference between ACOS and TACoS, and which one would you show an owner first? Why?

   - Which Amazon Ads reports have you used, and for what?

3. Send 2–3 LinkedIn posts or graphics you've written or designed (links or images).

4. Tell us your shift availability in Philippine time.

5. Optional: a 2-minute Loom or video introducing yourself in English.

title: Customer relations manager
description:
HEAT Nutrition

Customer Success & Growth Coordinator (Remote Virtual Assistant)

Position: Customer Success & Growth Coordinator

Location: Remote

Position Overview

HEAT Nutrition is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and results-driven Customer Success & Growth Coordinator to manage customer relationships, oversee customer accounts, and drive consistent growth in our weekly meal prep business.



This position is responsible for delivering a high-touch, concierge-style customer experience while ensuring existing customers continue ordering, inactive customers are reactivated, and prospective customers are consistently followed up with and converted.



The primary objective is simple: Increase weekly meal orders, grow recurring subscriptions, and maximize customer retention.



Key Responsibilities



1. Customer Account Management & Retention

, and other digital communication.

* Proactively contact customers who have stopped ordering.

2. Shopify Management

* Maintain accurate customer records and order information.

* Identify repeat purchasers and potential subscription customers.

3. GoHighLevel CRM & Pipeline Management

* Manage and organize prospect and customer pipelines.

* Ensure customer profiles, notes, tags, and opportunities remain updated.

* Track leads throughout the customer acquisition process.

* Execute follow-up sequences through SMS,
, and other approved communication channels.

* Identify stalled opportunities and proactively reengage prospects.

* Maintain accurate CRM records and follow-up tasks.



4. Prospecting & Outbound Customer Acquisition

* Conduct outbound prospecting to generate new meal prep customers.

* Contact prospective customers through approved outreach channels.

* Follow up with individuals who previously expressed interest in HEAT Nutrition.

* Convert qualified prospects into first-time meal prep customers.

* Promote introductory meal offers and recurring subscriptions.

* Maintain consistent daily outreach activity.



5. Subscription Growth & Customer Reactivation

* Convert one-time purchasers into repeat customers.

* Introduce qualified customers to weekly subscription options.

* Follow up with canceled, paused, or inactive customers.

* Identify reasons for customer cancellations and ordering inactivity.

* Implement approved customer reactivation campaigns.

* Work toward continuously increasing active subscriptions and weekly meal counts.



6. Customer Service & Concierge Experience

* Respond professionally and promptly to customer questions.

* Provide personalized assistance through digital communication.

* Help customers understand ordering deadlines, delivery procedures, and subscription benefits.

* Coordinate with internal operations when issues arise.

* Ensure every customer receives a convenient, positive, and consistent experience.



7. Reporting & Performance Tracking



* Track new customers acquired each week.

* Monitor returning and inactive customers.

* Report active subscription totals and subscription changes.

* Track weekly meal counts and order volume.

* Maintain outreach and follow-up activity records.

* Submit weekly performance summaries identifying progress, opportunities, and customer retention concerns.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated using measurable results:



* Weekly Meal Count: Consistent growth in total meals ordered.

* New Customer Acquisition: Number of new paying customers generated.

* Subscription Growth: Net increase in active weekly meal subscriptions.

* Customer Retention: Percentage of customers continuing to place orders.

* Customer Reactivation: Number of inactive customers successfully brought back.

* Lead Conversion: Percentage of qualified prospects converted into paying customers.

* Response Time: Timely responses to customer inquiries.

* CRM Accuracy: Consistent and accurate customer records, pipeline updates, and follow-up tracking.



Qualifications



* Experience in virtual assistance, customer success, customer service, or sales support.

* Experience with Shopify and GoHighLevel is strongly preferred.

* Strong written English communication skills.

* Comfortable communicating with customers through SMS,
, and social media messaging.

* Experience managing CRM pipelines and customer follow-up campaigns.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-motivated.

* Comfortable conducting cold outreach and following up with prospective customers.

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of measurable performance goals.

* A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and business growth.



What Success Looks Like



The ideal candidate takes ownership of our customer relationships and growth opportunities.



They don’t simply wait for customers to reach out. They proactively identify opportunities to acquire new customers, bring back inactive customers, encourage repeat orders, and convert existing customers into recurring subscribers.



The ultimate goal is to help HEAT Nutrition build a loyal, growing customer base that generates predictable, recurring weekly revenue.



Our Mission: To provide a simple, convenient, and life-changing experience through fresh, high-protein meals that make healthy eating easier.

title: CNC Machine Shops (Fusion 360): Paid Licensing of Archived 3-Axis Parts
description:
Summary

Do you run a CNC shop or have years of machined customer jobs sitting in your archive? We'll pay you to license them.

We're a San Francisco-based, YC-backed startup building real-world training data for physical AI and robotics. We need complete file packages for parts that were actually cut on a machine, not just modeled or simulated. This is a volume engagement: 50 parts minimum, up to 100 per partner, delivered in batches.

Compensation:

$100 USD per 5 approved bundles. 

What parts we want:

End-use parts made for a real customer job, 3-axis milled, with more than one setup or feature type. Metals and engineering plastics (POM, PEEK, nylon) are both fine. Typical examples include mould and die components (core/cavity inserts, sliders, lifters), housings and enclosures (gearbox, sensor, and pump housings), brackets, mounts and structural blocks, hydraulic manifolds and valve bodies, heat sinks and cold plates, machine-building parts (bearing blocks, end plates, carriages), robotics and drone parts (arm links, actuator housings, flanges), automotive and motorcycle parts (caliper brackets, throttle bodies, triple clamps), medical, lab, semiconductor, and optics components, consumer hardware like bike stems and camera cages, and heavy-equipment parts such as cylinder end caps and pivot blocks.



What we need for each part

- STEP model of the finished part as a single solid

- Original, editable Fusion 360 file (.f3d) with all setups and toolpaths

- Posted G-code for every setup (e.g., top + flip = two programs)

- Technical drawing (PDF) matching the model's dimensions

- Setup sheet: machine make/model and travels, material, stock size, workholding, number of setups, Fusion version and licence type

- A realistic quote/price estimate and a short provenance note: who machined it, where, and roughly when



Requirements:

- Parts must have been physically milled by you or your shop. Work that was only CAM-programmed for someone else's machine doesn't qualify.

- 3-axis milling only. No 3+2, 4-axis, 5-axis, router, or hybrid work.

- All CAM in Fusion 360 under a commercial licence. Files from Educational or Personal Use licences can't be accepted.

- The part must fit the travels of the machine you list, and all files must match each other.

- You must have the right to license every part. [Customer permission requirement.]



Not accepted:

- Fixtures and workholding: soft jaws, fixture plates, jigs, nests, or anything made for your own shop's use

- Wood, MDF, or foam

- Trivial parts: plain plates with holes, single-operation jobs, 2D profile cuts, engraving, nameplates

- More than 5 genuinely different designs per part family

- Parts never cut, test cuts, demo or training pieces

- Downloaded or open-source models

- Defence, export-controlled, or NDA parts

- Multi-body STEP files



How it works:

1. Pilot: Send 5 sample parts. Samples are paid at $20 each once approved and count toward your total. We review within 24 hours.

2. Batches: Deliver the rest in batches of [20]. Each batch is QC'd and paid on approval.

Parts that fail QC are returned for fixes, not paid as-is. Partners who consistently pass QC are offered ongoing contracts.

title: Amazon Marketplace Assistant (PPC & Inventory Management)
description:
About Us:

We are a growing, high-quality direct-to-consumer food brand with a rapidly expanding catalog on Amazon. We develop innovative pantry staples and pride ourselves on data-driven operations, healthy brand margins, and great product quality.



About the Role:

We are looking for an analytical, hands-on, and proactive Amazon Marketplace Assistant to work directly alongside the founder/operator. In this full-time, long-term role, your primary responsibility will be maintaining and scaling our Amazon store operations—with a strong focus on Amazon PPC advertising management and inventory tracking/forecasting.



You will act as the right-hand operator for marketplace execution, ensuring advertising spend is efficient, inventory never runs out, and listings remain healthy and competitive.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Amazon PPC & Advertising Management:

- Manage day-to-day PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.

- Execute keyword harvesting, bid optimizations, search term isolation, and regular negative keyword pruning.

- Monitor, evaluate, and optimize campaign performance against strict ACoS and TACoS targets.

- Identify wasted spend and scale high-converting keywords to support existing products and new launches.



2. Inventory Review & Restock Planning:

- Monitor FBA inventory levels, run-rates, and restock limits across all SKUs.

- Track days-of-supply (DOS) and flag low inventory well in advance to prevent stockouts.

- Assist in planning shipment quantities and reconciling inbound receiving discrepancies.



3. Marketplace Operations & Catalog Health:

- Monitor Seller Central account health, notifications, stranded inventory, and listing suppressions.

- Coordinate with Amazon Seller Support to resolve ticket escalations and listing errors.

- Support keyword research and backend listing updates using tools like Helium 10.

- Compile concise weekly performance reports covering ad spend, TACoS, sales volume, and inventory health.



What We Are Looking For:

- At least 1–2 years of direct, hands-on experience inside Amazon Seller Central.

- Proven track record running and optimizing Amazon PPC campaigns (must understand ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, and bid adjustments).

- Strong proficiency in Google Sheets / Excel (comfortable with formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and pivot tables).

- Familiarity with Amazon research & optimization tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar).

- High accountability, strong critical-thinking skills, and excellent written English.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection and dedicated workstation.

- Looking for a stable, long-term, full-time commitment (40 hours/week).



How to Apply (Attention-to-Detail Test):

We value team members who are meticulous and read instructions thoroughly. To be considered, please reply with the following:



1. Change the subject line of your message to: 

   "Amazon Operator Ready – [Insert how many years of Amazon PPC experience you have]"

2. Share a brief summary (3–4 sentences) of your experience managing Amazon PPC and Seller Central. Mention the tools you use (e.g., Helium 10, spreadsheets) and your typical approach to controlling TACoS/ACoS.

3. Briefly describe how you monitor inventory run-rates to prevent stockouts.

4. Confirm your availability to work full-time (40 hours/week) long-term.



Applications that do not follow these instructions or do not use the specified subject line will be automatically archived. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Tenant Relocation Specialist / Negotiator (Phone-Based, Full-Time)
description:
We are a property management company in New Jersey. We are hiring a full-time Tenant Relocation Specialist to call tenants and negotiate voluntary move-outs.



When an owner needs to renovate an apartment, we ask the current tenant to move out. In return, we offer a relocation package: moving expenses plus return of their security deposit. Your job is to explain this clearly and kindly, answer their questions, handle objections, and work with them toward a signed agreement and a smooth move-out.



What you will do:

- Call tenants (and follow up by text/email) to explain the situation and the offer

- Build trust and keep a respectful, calm tone, even when tenants are upset or worried

- Negotiate move-out terms and dates within the guidelines I give you

- Handle objections and tough questions with good judgment

- Keep clear notes on every call and every tenant (status, concerns, next steps)

- Follow up consistently until the case is resolved

- Report to me daily on progress



Requirements:

- Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, natural, easy-to-understand accent. This is the most important requirement

- Very high common sense and sharp judgment. You will often need to think on your feet

- Strong social skills: warm, patient, confident, and persuasive without being pushy

- Good negotiation and persuasion skills (experience in sales, customer service, collections, or phone work is helpful but not required)

- Reliable, organized, self-managed, and able to follow up without being reminded

- Stable internet and a quiet workspace, with a good headset

- Able to work US business hours (Eastern Time), Monday to Friday



Big plus:

- Fluent Spanish (many of our tenants speak Spanish)



No real estate experience needed. We will train you.



How to apply:

Please include a short voice recording (1-2 minutes) introducing yourself in English, and tell me about a time you successfully negotiated or resolved a difficult situation with someone. Also tell me whether you speak Spanish. Applications without the recording will not be considered.

title: Player Experience - Support Associate
description:
We’re looking for a Player Experience (PX)  Support Associate to join our team and provide thoughtful, accurate, and efficient support to our players.



You’ll help players resolve account, gameplay, purchase, and technical issues while also identifying bugs, recurring pain points, and opportunities to improve the overall player experience.



We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, communicates clearly, and genuinely enjoys games. Our games and processes continue to evolve, so being comfortable learning new systems and adapting to change is important.



What You’ll Do



- Respond to player questions and support requests through our helpdesk.

- Investigate account, gameplay, purchase, and technical issues and work toward appropriate resolutions.

- Identify, document, and escalate suspected bugs or technical issues with clear and useful information for the appropriate teams.

- Recognize recurring player issues and surface trends, feedback, and opportunities for improvement.

- Use internal tools, admin panels, and other systems to investigate player concerns.

- Review player-reported content and take appropriate action when required.

- Work with the team to improve macros, FAQs, internal documentation, and support workflows to make sure everything is up to date.

- Provide feedback and suggestions to help improve support processes and the overall player experience.

- Stay up to date with changes to our games, policies, tools, and support procedures.



What We’re Looking For



- 2+ years of experience in customer support, player support, or a similar role. Written chat or ticket-based support experience is strongly preferred.

- A college degree.

- Experience using a helpdesk platform is a plus, particularly Intercom.

- Excellent written English, with native or near-native fluency, and the ability to communicate clearly, naturally, and professionally.

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate an issue before reaching a conclusion.

- Good judgment and attention to detail when handling unusual or ambiguous player concerns.

- Comfort working with technical systems such as helpdesks, CRMs, admin panels, moderation tools, or similar platforms.

- Ability to learn new tools and adapt to changing processes and workflows.

- A genuine interest in and passion for games.

- Ability to work independently and communicate effectively in a fully remote environment.

- Availability to work assigned shifts, including day or night shifts as required.

- Reliable high-speed internet, electricity, and a suitable workstation.



Nice to Have



- Previous experience supporting a mobile, online, or live-service game or application.

- Experience with Intercom or similar helpdesk software.

- Experience with bug reporting, reproduction steps, or working with QA or development teams.

- Experience with content moderation or player safety workflows.

title: VA|Coaching Support & Data Operations

- Career growth opportunities within a growing UK-based company.

--------------------------

title: Marketing Lead / Lead Generation Manager – Painting Company (Meta + Google Ads)
description:
We're Smooth Finish Painting LLC, a residential and commercial painting company in Northwest Indiana (Crown Point, Schererville and Valparaiso area). We're growing, and we want a full-time marketing person whose main job is bringing in quality leads. We don't need someone who only posts pretty pictures. We need someone who knows where every lead came from, what it cost, and whether it turned into a paying job.



Right now an outside ad agency runs our ads, and we plan to bring that work in-house with you. You'll own our marketing from the first click to the closed job, and you'll report directly to the owner.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Lead capture and routing

- Watch every lead channel daily:
/Instagram, Google Ads, Google Business Profile, our website form, and phone/SMS

- Make sure every lead is captured, tagged by source, and sent to the right person fast so nothing slips through



Paid ads

- Set up, manage, optimize and report on Meta 
/Instagram) Ads and Google Ads campaigns

- Test offers, audiences, creatives and landing pages to lower cost per lead and raise lead quality

- Take over the campaigns our current agency runs



Local presence

- Manage and improve our Google Business Profile (posts, photos, reviews, Q&A)

- Own our local SEO for the NW Indiana service area

- Oversee social media: you draft the content in Canva and Buffer, and nothing posts until the owner approves it



Scorekeeping (this is a big part of the job)

- Track the full funnel in our CRM: leads, then estimates scheduled, then booked jobs, then closed jobs

- Track cost per lead, close rate, and cost per booked job for each channel

- Keep our numbers clean and up to date in Google Sheets and the CRM

- Send the owner a clear weekly report: what's working, what isn't, and what you'd change



Planning ahead

- Propose campaigns, seasonal pushes (spring exterior season, winter interiors, and so on) and new lead channels before we have to ask

- Spot problems early, like lead volume dropping, cost per lead rising, or slow follow-up, and bring solutions



TOOLS WE USE

GoHighLevel (white-labeled as Local PRO Connect), Dripjobs CRM, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Business Profile, Buffer, Canva, Google Sheets



WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

- The owner (you report to him)

- Our existing VA, who handles lead callbacks

- Our sales/estimating lead

- Our production manager



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience running both Meta Ads and Google Ads that produced leads for local or home-service businesses

- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel or a similar CRM/funnel tool

- Comfortable with numbers: you can build and read reports and explain them in plain English

- Strong written English

- Reliable internet and a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Some regular overlap with US Central time (at least 4 hours a day between 8 AM and 5 PM CT)



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with painting, HVAC, roofing, plumbing, landscaping or other home-service companies (a big plus)

- Experience with Dripjobs or other contractor CRMs

- Google Ads and/or Meta Blueprint certifications

- Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization experience

- Basic landing page or funnel building inside GoHighLevel

- Canva skills for ad creatives



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, long-term position: $800–$1,200 per month

- Raises based on results and tenure

- Direct access to the owner. Your ideas get heard, and if they work they get used.

- A chance to build the marketing function at a growing local company instead of being one of many accounts at an agency



HOW TO APPLY



Please read this part carefully. Generic copy-paste applications will be skipped.



1. Start your application with the phrase: PAINT LEADS

2. Answer these 5 questions:



   (1) Tell us about a home-service or local business you ran Meta or Google Ads for. What was the monthly ad budget, the cost per lead, and the number of leads per month?



   (2) How would you track a lead from first click to closed job? Walk us through your process and tools.



   (3) Which CRMs and funnel tools have you used? Have you used GoHighLevel? If so, what did you build or manage in it?



   (4) What is your expected monthly rate, and which hours can you work in US Central time?



   (5) Share a link to a portfolio, case study, or a short Loom video (under 5 minutes) showing a campaign you ran and its results.



3. Attach or link your resume.



Applications without "PAINT LEADS" at the top or without answers to all 5 questions won't be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview.



We look forward to hearing from you.



Damian Raber

Smooth Finish Painting LLC

title: Amazon trading expert
description:
AMAZON MARKETPLACE TRADING & LISTING OPTIMISATION SPECIALIST (REMOTE VA)



Company: Talking Tables

Location: Remote

Type: Long-term, ongoing opportunity

Experience: Proven Amazon trading and listing optimisation experience required. Vendor Central experience preferred.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Marketplace Trading Specialist to take ownership of a selection of our products (SKUs) and focus entirely on improving their sales performance, visibility and profitability on Amazon.



This is not an administrative VA role. We are looking for someone who understands how to grow sales on Amazon, can identify opportunities through data and competitor research, and knows how to turn those insights into measurable results.



You will be responsible for managing and optimising a portfolio of products, identifying what is holding back their performance and implementing improvements to drive growth.



We want someone who is proactive, analytical and commercially minded, rather than someone who simply completes tasks when instructed.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. LISTING OPTIMISATION & SEO



- Optimise product titles, bullet points, descriptions and backend search terms.

- Conduct keyword research to improve organic visibility and rankings.

- Review and improve product imagery, A+ Content and overall listing quality.

- Identify underperforming listings and implement improvements.

- Continuously test, review and refine listings based on performance data.



2. COMPETITOR & MARKET ANALYSIS



- Research competing products, brands and market trends.

- Analyse competitor pricing, positioning, imagery, keywords and content.

- Identify gaps and opportunities where our products can gain market share.

- Review pricing structures and recommend changes to improve competitiveness and profitability.

- Identify successful competitor strategies that could be applied to our listings.



3. DATA ANALYSIS & PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT



- Analyse Amazon performance data to understand what is driving or limiting sales.

- Diagnose issues such as declining sales, low conversion rates, poor visibility or reduced competitiveness.

- Use data to identify opportunities for growth and prioritise improvements.

- Monitor sales, conversion, traffic, keyword rankings and profitability.

- Track and report on the impact of listing changes, showing measurable results.



4. SKU OWNERSHIP & TRADING STRATEGY



- Take full ownership of an assigned portfolio of SKUs.

- Develop and implement an ongoing optimisation strategy for each product.

- Prioritise products and actions based on their potential commercial impact.

- Proactively suggest new ideas and improvements without waiting for instructions.

- Provide regular updates on what has been changed, why, and the results achieved.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential:



- Proven experience growing sales and improving product performance on Amazon.

- Strong knowledge of Amazon SEO, keyword research and listing optimisation.

- Experience conducting competitor research and pricing analysis.

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to diagnose performance issues using data.

- Experience using Amazon analytics and keyword research tools.

- A clear understanding of the relationship between traffic, conversion, pricing and profitability.

- Ability to work independently and take genuine ownership of results.



Highly Desirable:



- Experience working with Amazon Vendor Central (1P), rather than solely Seller Central (3P).

- Experience using tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout or similar.

- Experience managing and optimising products across multiple Amazon marketplaces, including the UK, US and Europe.

- Experience working with established consumer brands and competitive product categories.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



We are not measuring success by how many listings you edit or how many tasks you complete.



We want to see genuine improvements in the performance of the SKUs you manage, including:



- Increased sales and revenue.

- Improved organic search visibility and keyword rankings.

- Higher conversion rates.

- Stronger competitiveness against similar products.

- Improved profitability where possible.

- Clear, data-backed explanations of what has worked and what hasn't.



We expect you to treat your assigned products as your own portfolio and continuously look for ways to improve their performance.



HOW TO APPLY – IMPORTANT



We are only interested in candidates who can demonstrate previous success optimising Amazon listings.



Please include the following in your application:



1. Examples of Amazon listings you have personally worked on, ideally with ASINs or links to the products.

2. Evidence of the results you achieved, such as before-and-after sales performance, conversion rate improvements, keyword ranking changes or other relevant metrics. Screenshots or reports are welcome.

3. An explanation of what you actually did to achieve those results. We want to understand your personal contribution, not just the overall account performance.

4. Your experience with Amazon Vendor Central, if applicable, including which marketplaces you have managed.

5. The tools you use for competitor analysis, keyword research, listing optimisation and performance tracking.



Please also briefly explain how you would approach taking over a portfolio of 20 underperforming Amazon SKUs and deciding which improvements to prioritise.



Applications without relevant examples of previous work and measurable results are unlikely to be considered.



WHAT WE OFFER



- A long-term opportunity with an established UK consumer products brand.

- The opportunity to take real ownership of a portfolio of Amazon products.

- A focused role dedicated to trading, optimisation and commercial growth.

- Remote working with the potential for an ongoing working relationship.



We're looking for someone who can make a measurable difference to our Amazon performance, not simply maintain our existing listings.

title: Performance Video Editor – Meta Ads
description:
Performance Video Editor – Meta Ads

LERAVA is looking for a specialized Performance Video Editor for Meta Ads.



We are not looking for a traditional video editor who simply puts together visually appealing footage. We are looking for someone who understands how direct-response and performance creatives for
 and Instagram are structured and who can quickly produce high-performing videos based on scripts, competitor ads, and our Creative Strategy.

Our goal is to maintain a continuous output of new creatives that we can test on Meta and continuously improve based on actual performance data.

Your Responsibilities

You will be responsible for the entire video editing process — from the finished script to a Meta Ad that is ready to upload.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Researching and downloading relevant scripts and creative insights from TrendTrack

• Analyzing the competitors we provide and their successful video ads

• Executing our Creative Strategy and video briefs

• Selecting suitable B-roll footage from our Shade library

• Using Shade’s AI search to quickly find relevant scenes for individual parts of the script

• Downloading and professionally editing the required B-roll footage

• Creating voiceovers using ElevenLabs

• Synchronizing voiceovers, B-roll, text, music, and other creative elements

• Creating attention-grabbing hooks

• Adding subtitles and on-screen text

• Optimizing videos according to Meta Ads requirements and best practices

• Creating different hooks, angles, and creative variations for testing

• Localizing creatives for different countries and languages

• Performing quality control before publication

• Uploading finished creatives to Trybe

Media buying and campaign management are handled internally by our team.

Languages

Our creatives are currently produced in the following languages:

German, Italian, French, Spanish, Dutch, and Polish.

You do not need to speak all of these languages fluently.

Scripts and voiceovers will either be provided or created using our tools. However, it is essential that you work very carefully with the different language versions, voiceovers, subtitles, and on-screen text.

Our Workflow

You will receive access to all required tools and platforms:

TrendTrack → Script / Inspiration → Shade → B-Roll → ElevenLabs → Voiceover → Video Editing → Subtitles & Localization → Trybe → Media Buying

We will also provide an initial briefing covering:

• Our products and brands

• Our target audiences

• Our main competitors

• Successful creative angles

• Our preferred editing style

• Our previous best-performing creatives

After the onboarding phase, we expect you to be able to work as independently as possible.

Once per week, you will receive a performance briefing from our team. We will show you which creatives, hooks, angles, and concepts performed particularly well or poorly.

These insights should directly influence the following week’s creative production.

Produce → Test → Analyze → Iterate → Scale

Expected Output

We are looking for someone who can achieve a high creative production velocity.

As an initial target and weekly quota, we expect approximately a minimum of 8 fully edited video ads per language per week. Higher output is welcome if quality can be maintained.

For example, our weekly production may include:

• 3–5 new creative concepts

• Multiple hooks and creative variations

• Further iterations of winning creatives

• Localization of successful creatives across our six markets

If you can use our workflow to produce high-quality creatives faster, a higher output is explicitly encouraged.

However, one principle is very important to us:

Quality and performance are more important than quantity alone.

What We Expect From You

You should already have experience with Performance Video Editing for Meta Ads.

We particularly value:

• Experience creating
 and Instagram Ads

• A strong understanding of direct-response creatives

• An excellent sense for hooks and the first 1–3 seconds of a video

• Fast and dynamic editing

• Experience with UGC, B-roll, and voiceover-based ads

• A strong understanding of pacing, pattern interrupts, and viewer retention

• Experience with subtitles and on-screen text

• The ability to independently turn a script into a compelling, performance-focused video

• The ability to analyze existing winning ads and develop new variations from them

• Strong attention to detail when working with multiple languages

• High production speed

• A reliable, organized, and independent working style

Experience with AI-based creative workflows is a major plus.

Collaboration

Our internal communication takes place via Slack.

Working hours and projects are tracked through Hubstaff.

Payment is made weekly via Wise.

You will receive regular feedback from our Performance/Marketing Team and will be able to see which of your creatives actually perform well.

We are specifically looking for a long-term collaboration.

Application

Please send us:

1. A short introduction about yourself and your previous experience with Performance Video Editing.

2. Examples of Meta Ads that you personally edited.

3. If possible, examples of direct-response, UGC, or B-roll-based ads.

4. The editing software you primarily use.

5. How many comparable video ads you can realistically produce per week.

6. How many hours per week you are available.

7. Your hourly rate in USD or EUR.

8. Your time zone and country.

9. Your earliest possible start date.

Important: Please primarily send us examples of performance ads rather than traditional image, branding, or cinematic videos.

We are looking for an editor who wants to become a long-term part of our creative process and work with us to continuously produce better-performing ads based on real Meta performance data.

title: Amazon FBA Product Research & Supplier Sourcing VA — Long-Term Opportunity
description:
# Amazon FBA Product Research & Supplier Sourcing VA — Long-Term Opportunity



**Company:** Africa Unite Distribution  

**Position:** Amazon FBA Product Research & Supplier Sourcing Virtual Assistant  

**Employment Type:** Part-time to start, with potential for long-term growth  

**Experience Required:** 2+ years of Amazon product research experience preferred



## About Africa Unite



Africa Unite is a growing e-commerce business focused on bringing authentic African products to customers in the United States through Amazon FBA.



Our product categories include African foods, agricultural products, natural beauty products, and other culturally relevant products with strong market potential.



Our long-term vision is to build a scalable brand that connects African producers and manufacturers with the American market. We are looking for a reliable, analytical, and resourceful VA who can help us discover profitable opportunities and build a dependable supplier network.



## Your Primary Responsibilities



### 1. Amazon FBA Product Research



Your primary responsibility is to identify **10–20 qualified product leads per week** that meet our research criteria.



You will research products based on:



- Customer demand, sales volume, and sales trends.

- Competition, listing quality, review counts, and barriers to entry.

- Selling price, estimated FBA fees, shipping costs, and other relevant expenses.

- Estimated net profit, profit margin, ROI, and break-even advertising costs.

- Seasonality, price history, and market stability.

- Amazon restrictions, category approval, brand restrictions, and product eligibility.

- Potential risks involving expiration dates, food safety, labeling, documentation, and import requirements.



You must be able to distinguish genuinely attractive opportunities from products that look profitable but have excessive competition, unreliable demand, or significant compliance barriers.



### 2. Product Research Tools



You must be comfortable using:



- **Keepa:** Sales rank history, price history, Buy Box trends, competition, and demand stability.

- **SellerAmp SAS:** Profit calculations, estimated sales, eligibility checks, competition analysis, and sourcing decisions.

- Amazon Seller Central and Amazon search results.

- Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel for tracking and reporting.

- Additional research tools when they improve the accuracy of your findings.



You must know how to interpret the data rather than simply collect screenshots or copy numbers from software.



### 3. Our Product Sourcing Strategy



Our research will follow two primary tracks:



**70% — African products for private label**



Find African-origin products that could be developed under the Africa Unite brand, especially products with identifiable demand and opportunities to differentiate our offering.



Examples include:



- Tiger nuts and other African agricultural products.

- Sobolo ingredients and dried hibiscus products.

- Shea butter and natural beauty ingredients.

- Prekese, waakye leaves, alligator pepper, and other African spices and botanicals.

- Fufu ingredients and other African pantry staples.

- Other promising African food, agricultural, and personal-care products.



These are examples, not a restriction on your research. You should actively identify new opportunities beyond our current catalog.



**30% — Established African products and brands**



Research recognizable African products that already have demand in the United States and may offer reliable, repeatable sales opportunities.



For these products, investigate brand authorization requirements, invoices, wholesale pricing, competition, Amazon selling eligibility, and the potential for sustainable margins.



**Important:** We prioritize products that can be sourced consistently, sold compliantly, and reordered profitably. Do not recommend a product simply because it is African or has a high selling price.



### 4. Supplier Sourcing & Verification



Once a promising product is identified, research suppliers and help us determine the best sourcing option.



Responsibilities include:



- Finding manufacturers, wholesalers, farms, cooperatives, and exporters.

- Prioritizing reliable suppliers in Ghana and other African countries where appropriate.

- Comparing local US wholesalers against direct international sourcing.

- Requesting quotations, minimum order quantities (MOQs), samples, lead times, and payment terms.

- Comparing unit costs, packaging costs, shipping, customs duties, and other landed costs.

- Identifying suppliers that offer consistent quality and repeatable inventory.

- Checking supplier credibility, business documentation, references, and export capabilities.

- Determining whether suppliers can provide the documentation needed for Amazon and applicable US import requirements.

- Organizing supplier communications and maintaining a database of qualified contacts.



For international suppliers, you should be comfortable communicating professionally across time zones and following up persistently.



You will research and recommend suppliers. **All supplier approvals, purchases, and financial commitments must be authorized by the business owner.**



### 5. Product Eligibility, Compliance & Ungating Research



Before recommending a product, investigate whether Africa Unite can realistically sell it on Amazon.



This includes:



- Checking category, brand, and ASIN-level restrictions where applicable.

- Identifying potential approval or ungating requirements.

- Researching acceptable invoices, supplier qualifications, and documentation.

- Flagging products that may require FDA-related, food safety, cosmetics, labeling, or import compliance review.

- Identifying potential intellectual property, trademark, authenticity, or restricted-product risks.



Do not assume a product is ungateable merely because another seller offers it. Clearly distinguish verified eligibility from requirements that still need confirmation in Seller Central or with the relevant authority.



### 6. Product Listings & Growth Support



As needed, assist with:



- Competitor listing analysis and keyword research.

- Product title, bullet point, and listing improvement suggestions.

- Identifying listing weaknesses and opportunities for differentiation.

- Reviewing customer feedback and recurring complaints.

- Tracking product performance, inventory, and competitor changes.

- Providing research that supports pricing and advertising decisions.



Product research and sourcing will remain your primary responsibilities.



## Weekly Deliverables



You are expected to deliver **10–20 qualified product leads per week**, not simply a list of product ideas.



Each lead must include:



1. Product name and proposed Amazon marketplace.

2. Existing Amazon listing or relevant competitor examples.

3. Estimated monthly sales and supporting demand evidence.

4. Current selling price and competition analysis.

5. Keepa and SellerAmp findings, where applicable.

6. Estimated product cost, FBA fees, landed cost, and other material expenses.

7. Estimated net profit per unit, profit margin, ROI, and break-even considerations.

8. Selling restrictions, ungating requirements, and compliance concerns.

9. At least one potential supplier, including contact information and pricing when available.

10. Recommended next step and a brief explanation of why the product is worth considering.



Maintain an organized Google Sheet with source links, calculations, research dates, supplier details, and a clear status for every lead.



Prioritize quality and accuracy over inflated lead counts. Clearly flag estimates, assumptions, and missing information.



## Required Qualifications



- At least 2 years of hands-on Amazon product research experience preferred.

- Practical knowledge of Amazon FBA, with an understanding of FBM where relevant.

- Strong working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp SAS.

- Ability to calculate landed costs, FBA fees, net profit, ROI, and margins.

- Experience sourcing products and communicating with suppliers.

- Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written English and professional communication.

- Proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel.

- High attention to detail and the ability to meet weekly deadlines.

- Comfortable working independently and presenting evidence to support recommendations.



Experience with African products, international trade, food or beauty products, private-label sourcing, and US import requirements is a significant advantage.



## What We Value



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, thinks like a business operator, and understands that a product must be profitable, sellable, and reliably sourced to be a good opportunity.



We value initiative, honesty, data-driven decisions, clear communication, and long-term thinking.



We do not want generic product lists, copied research, unrealistic profit estimates, or suppliers that have not been properly evaluated.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction describing your Amazon FBA product research and sourcing experience.

2. The tools you have used, specifically Keepa and SellerAmp SAS, and how you use them to evaluate products.

3. An example of a product you researched, including its selling price, estimated sales, costs, net profit, ROI, competition, and sourcing approach. Please remove any confidential client information.

4. An example of a supplier you identified or a product you helped source, including the process you used to evaluate the supplier.

5. Your expected monthly compensation and weekly availability.

6. Confirm whether you can consistently research and submit 10–20 qualified product leads per week.



**Please begin your application with the words “AFRICA UNITE” so we know you have read the full posting.**



We are looking for a dependable long-term partner who can help Africa Unite discover the right products, establish reliable sourcing relationships, and grow a sustainable Amazon business.

title: Growth Marketer / Social Media & UGC Creator – SaaS Launch
description:
Part-time initially: 15–20 hours per week

Long-term opportunity for the right person

Remote – Philippines



We are preparing to launch a new SaaS platform into the Australian real estate/property industry and are looking for someone smart, creative and highly motivated to help us get it in front of as many potential customers as possible.



This is NOT a basic social media manager position.



We don't need someone whose main skill is scheduling three Canva posts per week.



We want someone who understands growth.



Your job is to help us turn a new software product into something our target market keeps seeing, hearing about and ultimately signing up for.



What you'll be doing



You will work directly with the founder to execute an aggressive launch and ongoing growth strategy.



This may include:



Creating short-form videos, Reels and TikToks



Creating UGC-style content demonstrating the software



Turning product features into interesting, benefit-driven content



Posting and distributing content across
, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube



Finding relevant
 groups, communities and industry conversations



Engaging genuinely with potential customers online



Identifying influencers, creators and industry pages we could work with



Researching competitors and finding opportunities they're missing



Testing different hooks, messages and content styles



Repurposing successful content across multiple platforms



Helping with appropriate direct outreach



Tracking where leads, trials and customers actually come from



Reporting what's working and suggesting what we should try next



We are happy to experiment.



If you have an idea that could put our software in front of the right people, we want to hear it.



What matters to us



You don't need a university degree or 10 years of marketing experience.



We care much more about whether you can actually make things happen.



Ideally you:



Have excellent written and spoken English



Understand TikTok, Instagram,
 and LinkedIn



Can create and edit good short-form video



Understand hooks and why people stop scrolling



Are comfortable using tools such as CapCut and Canva



Understand UGC-style content



Have some understanding of SaaS, B2B or lead generation



Can use AI tools effectively without producing generic AI rubbish



Are comfortable testing ideas and learning from results



Can work independently rather than waiting for instructions every hour



Care more about generating sign-ups and customers than vanity metrics



Experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn outreach,
 outreach or Australian businesses would be an advantage, but isn't essential.



About the product



We're launching a substantial new software platform built specifically around the needs of the real estate/property industry.



It combines capabilities that businesses currently use multiple separate products and workflows to achieve.



There is a lot to demonstrate, which means we'll have plenty of material for content.



You will be able to work closely with the founder and will have access to help developing marketing ideas, scripts, copy and campaigns. We don't expect you to invent everything alone.



What we do expect is someone who can execute quickly, bring their own ideas and consistently get the product in front of potential customers.



Hours & pay



Initially approximately 15–20 hours per week.



We're flexible about when you work, although some availability during Australian business hours will be useful.



Please tell us your expected hourly rate in your application.



This is not intended to be a short-term gig.



If you're good and the product grows, there is an opportunity for the role, hours and compensation to grow with it.



How to apply



Please don't send us a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with the words:



"I want to grow this."



Then answer these five questions:



1. Tell us about one product, business or account you helped grow. What did you personally do, and what was the result?



2. If we gave you a brand-new SaaS product and almost nobody knew it existed, what are the first three things you would do to get potential customers seeing it?



3. Send us links to 2–3 examples of content you personally created. Short-form video examples are particularly useful.



4. Which are you strongest at: content creation, organic growth, paid advertising, outreach/lead generation, or something else?



5. What hourly rate are you looking for, and how many hours per week are you currently available?



One final thing:



Please do not use ChatGPT to write the entire application for you.



We use AI extensively ourselves and have no problem with you using it.



But we're hiring you, not ChatGPT.



We want to see how you think, communicate and generate ideas.



If you're creative, commercially minded, enjoy experimenting and would like to help take a new software product from launch to serious growth, we'd love to hear from you.
