title: SEO Specialist
description:
We're  an Australian web and branding agency specialising in premium websites and digital marketing for architects, builders, and property businesses.



We're looking for an experienced, hands-on SEO Specialist with strong Webflow experience to take ownership of the day-to-day execution of our clients' SEO campaigns.



This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who already has a strong understanding of SEO, knows how to optimise websites effectively, and can confidently implement improvements without constant guidance.



Our SEO strategy, keyword research, and campaign direction will be handled by our strategist. Your responsibility is to take that strategy and execute it to a high standard.



What You'll Be Doing:



– On-page SEO: Optimising titles, meta descriptions, headings, content, images, URLs, and page structure.



– Technical SEO: Identifying and resolving indexing issues, crawl errors, broken links, redirects, canonical tags, and other technical problems.



– Webflow SEO: Making SEO improvements directly inside Webflow, including CMS collections, page structures, redirects, and technical settings.



– Internal linking: Identifying and implementing strategic internal linking opportunities across websites.



– Google Business Profile: Optimising listings, services, categories, posts, and local SEO signals.



– Content optimisation: Publishing and optimising service pages, landing pages, and blog articles.



– SEO reporting: Monitoring keyword rankings, organic traffic, leads, and overall campaign performance.



– Conversion optimisation: Identifying opportunities to improve website enquiries, landing pages, and calls to action.



What We're Looking For:



– 3+ years of proven, hands-on SEO experience, preferably with agencies or service-based businesses.



– Webflow experience is required. You must be confident working inside the Webflow Designer and CMS, not just editing basic content.



– Advanced understanding of on-page SEO, technical SEO, internal linking, and local SEO.



– Demonstrated experience improving organic keyword rankings and traffic through SEO implementation.



– Strong knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, Google Business Profile, and tools such as Ahrefs or SEMrush.



– Ability to independently audit website pages, identify SEO issues, and implement the necessary fixes.



– Understanding of local SEO and lead generation for service-based businesses.



– Excellent attention to detail, organisation, and communication.



– Ability to work independently, take initiative, and consistently deliver high-quality work.



What Success Looks Like:



You'll be provided with the overall SEO strategy, target keywords, and campaign priorities.



From there, we expect you to confidently handle the execution, identify additional opportunities, resolve issues, and ensure that every website is properly optimised.



We don't want someone who simply follows a checklist. We want someone who understands why SEO changes matter, can make informed decisions, and takes ownership of their work.



Our focus is on real results: improved keyword rankings, qualified organic traffic, and more enquiries for our clients.



Role Details



– Location: Philippines (Remote)



– Hours: Initially 15–20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time role.



– Schedule: Flexible hours between 9am to 6pm Brisbane time



– Long-term opportunity as our SEO client portfolio grows.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



SEO experience: Share an SEO campaign where you personally implemented changes that improved rankings or organic traffic. What did you do, and what were the results?



Webflow experience: How long have you worked with Webflow, and what SEO-related tasks have you personally implemented within it? Please share examples of Webflow websites you've worked on.



Technical SEO: If a service page is indexed but struggling to rank for its target keyword, how would you investigate and improve it?



Availability: How many hours per week can you work, and what is your expected hourly rate in AUD?



Important: Applications without demonstrated SEO experience and practical Webflow experience will not be considered.



Please include examples of websites you've personally optimised and explain your involvement.

MyCleanBnb is a professional cleaning company covering Gold Coast, Brisbane and Tweed in Australia. Currently serving short-term rentals and expanding into post-construction cleaning. We’ve built a solid foundation with tools like Operto Teams and QuickBooks and are now ready to take our systems to the next level with automation and streamlined digital workflows.



Your Mission



We’re hiring a Remote Digital Solutions Specialist to help us optimise and automate multiple business processes using cloud-based tools and lightweight, serverless integrations. You’ll be responsible for designing and implementing automation that connects tools we already use, replaces clunky spreadsheets, and supports sales, operations, onboarding, training, and team monitoring.



What You’ll Work On



1. Quoting Automation & Sales Follow-Up System

• Replace the manual Google Sheet quote calculator with a dynamic, form-driven solution.

• Use Google Forms + Apps Script to automate pricing estimates and generate client-ready quotes.

• Create lightweight sales pipeline tracking tools to follow up and convert quotes into jobs.

• Trigger updates to Operto Teams, QuickBooks, and property/job rate spreadsheets when quotes are accepted.

 

2. Cleaner Onboarding & SOP Platform

• Migrate SOPs into Whale, Trainual (or any other recommended tool) and help structure the training modules.

• Design a tech-based onboarding experience with tracking and automated assignments for new team members.

• Automate status updates based on SOP completion.



3. Quality Assurance Reporting & Monitoring Dashboards

• Connect and simplify existing QA spreadsheets (from Google Forms, WhatsApp images, client feedback).

• Build dashboards to track service failures, team trends, and key cleaning KPIs.

• Automate alerts or reports for internal decision-making.



4. Spreadsheet Process Consolidation & Integration

• Review and clean up multiple existing Google Sheets (e.g. cleaner rates, cleaner availability, categorisation).

• Link them with Google Apps Script and automate updates where possible.

• Provide dashboards or reporting tools to make data more actionable.



5. Operto Teams & QuickBooks Usage Optimisation

• Audit current workflows in Operto Teams (scheduling, tasks) and QuickBooks (invoicing, accounting).

• Recommend better usage of features and ensure integration is seamless.

• Automate manual data entries between quoting, task scheduling, and invoicing.



6. Virtual Assistant Monitoring

• Implement WorkTime, Controlio (or any other recommended tool) to ensure team members are active during working hours.

• Set up dashboards or alerts to flag inactivity or productivity concerns.



7. Basic Website Updates

• Add a new page for the post-construction cleaning service to the company website.

• Edit layout, text, or visuals as needed (basic CMS knowledge required).



Tools You’ll Be Using

Automation & Logic: Google Apps Script, Google Cloud Functions, AWS Lambda (serverless), Zapier, Make

Forms & Quoting: Google Forms, Sheets

Scheduling: Operto Teams

Accounting: QuickBooks

SOP & Onboarding: Whale, Trainual

Monitoring: WorkTime, Controlio

Dashboards: Google Data Studio, Airtable

Website: WordPress / Webflow / Wix (basic updates only)



Ideal Candidate

• Experience with Google Apps Script, serverless automation, and process mapping

• Strong understanding of tools like Zapier, Make, and cloud-based solutions

• Clear documentation and process development habits

• Familiar with form-based UI, data structure, and process logic

• Bonus: familiar with property services, hospitality, or cleaning businesses



How to Apply

Complete the following application form and submit.

title: US Tax Preparer (1040/1065/1120-S/1120) - Drake - CPA-Led US Firm - Part-Time, Full-Time in Tax Season
description:
ABOUT US

Prime & Ledger CPAs is a US CPA firm (Arkansas) serving small businesses nationwide - especially restaurants, salons and their owners. The firm is led by a CPA with Big Four and large-corporate tax experience. We prepare individual, partnership, S corporation and C corporation returns, plus FICA tip credit (IRC Section 45B) amended returns.



We work differently from most firms: we built our own tax preparation software ("P&L") that imports last year's return, bulk-imports client data, computes the return, and reconciles it against Drake Tax before filing. You will be trained on it. We want someone who wants to work accurately and efficiently with good tools - not someone who wants to key every number by hand.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Part-time (about 4 hours/day) year-round, moving to full-time (8 hours/day) January 15 - April 30 and August 15 - October 15.

- $7 - $10 per hour depending on experience and test results (about $600 - $900/month part-time; $1,200 - $1,800/month full-time in season). Raises for accuracy and turnaround.

- Flexible hours, but you must overlap at least 4 hours daily with US Central Time (e.g., 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM CT = 9:00 PM - 1:00 AM Philippine time).



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Import prior-year returns into our software and verify every extracted line and carryforward (capital loss, passive loss, QBI, Section 179, NOL).

- Organize client documents and bulk-import W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, 1098s, trial balances and payroll data.

- Prepare Forms 1040 (Schedules A, B, C, D/8949, E, SE), 1065, 1120-S and 1120, including K-1s, depreciation (Form 4562) and state returns.

- Reconcile each return in our software to Drake Tax line by line, explain every difference, and clear Drake diagnostics and e-file messages.

- Compare each return to the prior year and explain significant changes.

- Write clear review notes for the CPA reviewer and resolve review comments promptly.

- Draft open-items lists for clients (no direct client contact unless asked).

- Off-season: bookkeeping clean-up, payroll reports for FICA tip credit analysis, and extensions.



MUST HAVE

- At least 2 full US tax seasons PREPARING returns (not only data entry) for a US CPA or EA firm.

- Hands-on experience with Form 1040 AND at least one of Form 1065 or 1120-S.

- Professional tax software experience. Drake strongly preferred; UltraTax, Lacerte, ProSeries, ProConnect or CCH accepted.

- Solid understanding of K-1s, basis, depreciation, and Schedule C/E reporting.

- Excellent written English; comfortable following checklists and written procedures.

- Reliable internet with backup power (UPS or generator) and a quiet, private workspace.

- A US PTIN, or willingness to obtain one when hired.

- Willing to sign an NDA, confidentiality and data-protection agreements, and provide an NBI clearance.



NICE TO HAVE

- Philippine CPA, or US EA / CPA candidate.

- Restaurant, salon or hospitality clients; payroll registers; Form 8846 (FICA tip credit).

- Multi-state returns, BBA partnership rules, Form 7203.

- QuickBooks Online or Xero.



SECURITY (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

You will work only inside our secure remote environment. No client data on personal devices, no downloads, no screenshots, no copying files outside our systems. Access is monitored. These rules protect our clients under US federal law (IRC Section 7216).



HOW WE HIRE

1. Apply using the instructions below.

2. Short video call (20 minutes).

3. PAID test: prepare a sample return with planted issues in our software and Drake, then write review notes.

4. 30-day paid trial, then a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY (follow exactly or your application will not be reviewed)

Start your application with "P&L Tax Season Ready" and answer:

1. How many US tax seasons have you worked, for what type of firm, and which return types did you prepare yourself?

2. Which tax software have you used, and for how many seasons? If Drake, which years?

3. Describe one difficult return you prepared and how you resolved the issue.

4. Do you have a PTIN? Will you get one if hired?

5. Your expected hourly rate, and whether you can work full-time January 15 - April 30.

title: Senior Accounts Payable Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team and support the day-to-day accounts payable operations of an Australian company.



The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately processing supplier invoices, maintaining vendor accounts, reconciling transactions, and ensuring payments are processed accurately and on time. The role will primarily use Dext and Xero will work closely with the Australian finance and operations teams.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong attention to detail who enjoys working with numbers, following and improving processes, and maintaining accurate financial records.



What you'll do

-Process and code supplier invoices accurately in Dext and Xero

-Organize scheduled payments and prepare them for approval

-Handle urgent payments through Airwallex

-Respond to supplier queries and collaborate with the team on Slack

-Support month-end tasks and share ideas for improving how we work



What we're looking for

-3+ years in AP or a similar finance role

-Experience in supporting Australian businesses

-Experience with Xero and Dext

-Strong attention to detail, with the ability to work quickly and accurately

-Reliable, organized, and takes ownership of their work

-Clear written English

-Bonus: experience improving or automating finance processes



What’s in it for you?



This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

title: Long-Form YouTube Editor for Finance Education Channel (Documentary Style) - Part-Time, Growth to Full-Time
description:
Long-Form YouTube Editor for Finance Education Channel (Documentary Style) 



Type of employment:

Part Time



Job description:



About the channel



I run The Capital Vault, a US-based capital advisory that helps established business owners ($2M-$20M revenue) secure growth capital for buyouts, acquisitions, expansions, and debt restructures. I’m building a YouTube channel that explains how business financing actually works: why banks say no, how lenders read a P&L, how a $2M deal actually gets structured, and the parts of the money system nobody explains to business owners.



The audience is business owners, operators, and people who want to understand capital. The tone is an insider pulling back the curtain. Not hype, not “get rich,” not finance-bro content. Think of it as the finance channel that respects the viewer’s intelligence.



I’m looking for a long-form editor who can turn my raw talking-head recordings into polished, high-retention videos that match a specific visual style.



The video style (this is the important part)



Every video follows the same visual language. Before you apply, make sure this is a style you can execute and enjoy:



Documentary feel, not vlog feel. Think clean, cinematic, deliberate. Reference the pacing and polish of channels like Johnny Harris, Ali Abdaal’s long-form explainers, and the Hormozi-style business breakdowns. Confident cuts, no jump-cut chaos.

High contrast, dark and clean. Deep navy and black backgrounds, gold accents for emphasis. Minimal color palette. Everything looks expensive and intentional.

Numbers on screen, always. This is a finance channel, so every key figure ($2M deal, 60 days, 27-point approval gap) appears as bold on-screen text the moment I say it. Big, clean, sans-serif, animated in with subtle motion.

Charts and explainers that teach. When I explain a concept (DSCR, a capital stack, why a bank declined a file), you build a simple animated graphic that makes it click: bars rising, a flow diagram, a before-and-after comparison. Simple beats fancy. The graphic exists to make the idea land, not to show off.

Captions on everything. Clean, readable, styled to match the brand. Key phrases highlighted.

B-roll that’s relevant and original. Screen recordings, documents, my own footage, custom graphics. No generic stock footage of handshakes and skylines. If a visual doesn’t add meaning, it doesn’t go in.

Hooks that hold. The first 30 seconds are tight and visual: the claim, the number, the question, on screen fast. You understand retention curves and cut for them.

No gimmicks. No zoom-in-every-3-seconds, no meme sound effects, no over-edited energy. Calm authority. The edit should feel like the viewer is being let in on something.



If you can watch a 15-minute Johnny Harris or a Hormozi breakdown and explain why the edit holds attention, you’ll understand what I’m after.



What you’ll do



Edit 1-2 long-form videos per week (8-20 minutes final length) from raw talking-head footage I record, plus a script for each

Cut filler, tighten pacing, and structure the video so retention holds from the hook to the close

Build the on-screen text, number callouts, captions, and simple animated charts and explainers that illustrate financial concepts

Build clean intros, chapter cards, transitions, and end screens in the brand style

Source or create relevant B-roll (screen recordings, documents, graphics), never generic stock

Deliver a first cut within 48-72 hours, revisions within 24

Study my past videos and the reference channels I share, match the style, then improve on it over time

Flag anything in the footage that could be stronger (a better order, a cut that would hold attention better). I want an editor with opinions.



What I’m looking for



2+ years editing long-form YouTube content, with a portfolio of 8-20 minute videos you’ve personally cut

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts: you know how to hold attention for 15 minutes, not just 15 seconds

Clean motion graphics and text animation (simple, professional, consistent)

Comfortable turning numbers I give you into simple charts and visual explainers

Proficient in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (After Effects a plus)

Reliable, communicative, and able to work independently from a brief

Comfortable with finance and business content (no finance background required, but you take the material seriously and ask when you don’t understand a concept)

Bonus: thumbnail design, short-form clipping from long-form (Opus Clip, Vizard), or experience with educational/explainer channels



How we’ll work



Paid trial: you’ll edit one long-form video from footage and a script I provide, so we can both see if the fit is right

Clear brief and script for every video, feedback in writing, workflow in Slack

Payment every two weeks via bank transfer

Original B-roll and graphics only. No generic stock footage.

Consistent weekly volume. This is a steady role, not one-off gigs.



To apply, include



Links to 3-5 long-form YouTube videos you edited (8+ minutes). Educational, finance, business, or documentary-style content preferred.

One sentence on why the edit in your best sample holds attention

Your editing software

Your availability per week and your rate



Start your application with the words “CAPITAL VAULT” so I know you read the full post.



I’m looking for someone to grow with. If the trial goes well, this becomes a steady long-term role, with the option to expand into short-form clipping, thumbnails, and a larger content operation as the channel grows.



Wage/Salary:

$500-$900/month (part-time, based on experience and output), with growth to full-time





:

The Capital Vault



Skills (select up to 3):

Video Editing, Motion Graphics, YouTube Content Creation

title: B2B Appointment Setter / Cold Caller - Med Spa Industry
description:
About Velo Systems



Velo Systems helps established med spas improve how they handle inbound calls and booking opportunities using AI-powered receptionist technology.



We are currently building our outbound sales team and are looking for an experienced B2B appointment setter who is confident speaking with business owners and decision-makers.



This is a sales position, not a basic virtual assistant or data-entry role.



You will be responsible for starting conversations with med spa owners, identifying potential problems around missed or unanswered calls, handling objections, and booking qualified appointments for our closer.



You will not be responsible for closing the final sale.



What You’ll Do



Your main responsibility is to generate qualified sales appointments through outbound calling.



You will:



- Make outbound cold calls to med spas

- Speak with business owners and decision-makers

- Navigate receptionists and gatekeepers

- Identify potential pain around missed or unanswered calls

- Create interest in Velo Systems

- Handle common objections

- Lightly qualify prospects

- Book qualified appointments

- Follow up with interested prospects

- Confirm appointments

- Keep the CRM updated

- Maintain consistent daily activity



The sales process is simple:



Cold call → Conversation → Light qualification → Appointment → Closer



Our closer handles the deeper discovery, demonstration, pricing, objections, and closing.



Who We’re Looking For



Required



- 2+ years of proven B2B cold calling or appointment-setting experience

- Strong spoken English

- Confident and professional phone presence

- Experience speaking with business owners or decision-makers

- Strong objection-handling ability

- Ability to have natural conversations instead of simply reading a script

- Strong follow-up habits

- Reliable internet connection

- Quiet workspace

- Ability to consistently work 9 AM - 5 PM Eastern Time



Experience selling marketing services, SaaS, AI, agency services, healthcare, med spa services, or other B2B services is a strong advantage.



We care more about what you have actually produced than how impressive your resume sounds.



What We’re Looking For



You should be comfortable hearing:



“Not interested.”



“Just send me an
.”



“We already have a receptionist.”



“How much does it cost?”



“I’m too busy.”



“Call me later.”



You should be able to stay calm, think on your feet, and keep the conversation moving without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.



You should also know when a prospect is not a good fit.



We care about qualified appointments, not simply filling the calendar.



Daily Activity



Our initial target is approximately:



100 to 150 outbound attempts per day



This is not a competition to make meaningless calls.



We care about the entire funnel:



Calls → Conversations → Decision-makers → Qualified prospects → Appointments → Shows → Clients



A setter who makes 150 poor calls is not more valuable than someone who makes 100 high-quality calls and consistently produces qualified opportunities.



Compensation



$500 USD/month base



Plus:



Uncapped performance bonuses



Performance bonuses are tied to qualified appointments that attend and clients generated from your appointments.



There is no ceiling on performance earnings.



The exact bonus structure will be explained during the interview.



Our goal is to reward people who actually produce results.



Training



You will not simply receive a phone number and be told to start dialing.



Before working with live leads, you will receive training on:



- Velo Systems

- Our AI receptionist solution

- Our target market

- Cold-call structure

- Receptionist and gatekeeper handling

- Qualification

- Objection handling

- Appointment booking

- Calendly

- CRM usage

- Follow-up

- Appointment confirmation



You will also complete roleplay before beginning live outbound.



How We Measure Performance



We track the entire sales funnel:



Outbound Attempts

↓

Connections

↓

Decision-Maker Conversations

↓

Qualified Prospects

↓

Appointments Booked

↓

Appointments Showed

↓

Closed Clients



We use these numbers to identify where the sales process can be improved.



You will also receive coaching based on actual recorded calls.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term position with the company.



As the sales operation grows, there will be opportunities for increased earning potential and additional responsibility for strong performers.



Application Process



Please answer every question below.



Incomplete applications will not be considered.



1. How many years of B2B cold-calling experience do you have?



2. How many years of appointment-setting experience do you have?



3. What industries or types of businesses have you previously called?



4. Were your leads primarily cold, warm, inbound, or a mixture?



Please explain.



5. Approximately how many outbound calls did you make per day in your previous role?



6. Approximately how many qualified appointments did you generate per week or month?



7. What was your approximate appointment show rate?



If you don’t know, just say so.



8. Who were you typically calling?



For example:



- Business owners

- CEOs

- Managers

- Receptionists

- Consumers



9. What countries were you calling?



10. What was the most difficult objection you regularly encountered, and how did you handle it?



Roleplay Question 1



Imagine you’re calling a med spa owner.



They say:



“We already have a receptionist. We’re not interested in an AI receptionist.”



What would you say?



Write your response exactly as you would say it on the phone.



Roleplay Question 2



The owner says:



“Just send me an
.”



What would you say?



Voice Recording



Please provide a 60 to 90 second voice recording introducing yourself.



Tell us:



- Your sales experience

- Your cold-calling experience

- What type of businesses you’ve called

- Why you believe you’d be a strong fit for this position

- We want to hear your natural speaking voice, confidence, communication style, and professionalism.



Work Setup



Please confirm that you have:



- Reliable computer

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Quality headset/microphone

- Quiet workspace

- Ability to work 9 AM - 5 PM Eastern Time



Attention to Detail



At the very end of your application, include:



VELO SALES



This lets us know that you read the entire job post.
